titles.name: One Piece
titles.description: Monkey D. Luffy sails with his crew of Straw Hat Pirates through the Grand Line to find the treasure One Piece and become the new king of the pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 1172
episodes.description: A giant snake attacks the Walrus School, sending the students into a panic. Principal Kiba and Saul defeat it, but the trouble doesn't end there.

episodes.name: Episode 1165
episodes.description: After Robin’s group visits the Owl Library, the giants host a welcoming feast for the Straw Hats. The two mysterious figures set out to find Loki.

episodes.name: Episode 1168
episodes.description: After learning of Saint Shamrock’s bloodline, Loki threatens him but soon comes face-to-face with Shamrock’s sinister shape-shifting sword, Cerberus.

episodes.name: Episode 1163
episodes.description: After the Straw Hats arrive in the Western Village, Robin finally reunites with her friend Saul, who saved her from the edge of despair long ago.

episodes.name: Episode 1174
episodes.description: As Ripley and Franky encounter Lilith and Bonney at a high-tech facility, a monster appears. Meanwhile, a giant skeleton attacks the village.

episodes.name: Episode 1164
episodes.description: As Robin and Saul enjoy a happy reunion, Lilith says she wants to build a new lab in Elbaph. The Straw Hats split up and learn more about the island.

episodes.name: Episode 1173
episodes.description: As Saul moves to halt the sleepwalking children, Elbaph’s fire brigade hurries to extinguish the burning forest, only to face a far bigger obstacle.

episodes.name: Episode 1159
episodes.description: As the Straw Hats continue trying to flee from the angered Sun God, Nami realizes that the Block Kingdom blueprint reveals a hidden gimmick.

episodes.name: Episode 1171
episodes.description: Franky learns about a treetop village that had to be severed from the Jewel Tree Adam. Meanwhile, Luffy and Zoro argue over whether to release Loki.

episodes.name: Episode 1156
episodes.description: Having left Egghead, the Straw Hat Pirates head to Elbaph with the Giant Pirate Crew. One month earlier, a strange incident unfolds on Gartel Island.

episodes.name: Episode 1161
episodes.description: In the Underworld, the imprisoned Accursed Prince Loki offers to destroy a rival pirate crew of Luffy’s choice in exchange for freedom.

episodes.name: Episode 1176
episodes.description: Jimbei puts out the flames, but the children’s march continues. Meanwhile, Gunko appears before Nami and the others in a terrifying display of power.

episodes.name: Episode 1158
episodes.description: Luffy and the others meet a grasshopper-riding giant who says the land was created by the Sun God and warns them not to go beyond the castle.

episodes.name: Episode 1167
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Nami and Road explore Aurust Castle in search of the key to Loki’s chains. In the Underworld, Loki endures attacks from Gunko.

episodes.name: Episode 1157
episodes.description: Nami wakes up scared and alone in a strange castle made of blocks. After fending off a giant bee, she hears Usopp's panicked voice.

episodes.name: Episode 1170
episodes.description: Rising to the challenge, Luffy attempts to take the key from Mr. Ya — who is actually Scopper Gaban, one of the Pirate King's most trusted crewmates.

episodes.name: Episode 1160
episodes.description: The Straw Hats escape the Block Kingdom, only to find themselves in front of a huge suspension bridge in a vast snowy landscape. Two giants approach.

episodes.name: Episode 1166
episodes.description: The two mysterious figures overpower the Aurust Castle guards and search for Loki. Meanwhile, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God, Nika.

episodes.name: Episode 1175
episodes.description: While being nursed back to health with Goldberg's cooking, Loki realizes that Luffy's admiration for Shanks reminds him of his younger self.

episodes.name: Episode 1169
episodes.description: While searching the castle, Luffy's group stumbles across the throne room and finds a magic sigil on the floor. Suddenly, a voice speaks to Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 1162
episodes.description: Zoro's group flees from Road. Leaping out of the Underworld, Luffy encounters the giants Geld and Goldberg, who have the Thousand Sunny with them.

episodes.name: Episode 176
episodes.description: A battle between Zoro, Ganfor, Wyper and Ohm begins. During the fight, Zoro notices the wounded Chopper on the ground and rushes to his side.

episodes.name: Episode 177
episodes.description: A deathmatch unfolds inside a barbed wire dome where one prick can cause serious harm. Nami and the others reunite with Luffy inside the giant python.

episodes.name: Episode 190
episodes.description: An ominous thundercloud descends upon Angel Island and makes it disappear without a trace. Nami insists on escaping, but Luffy refuses to leave.

episodes.name: Episode 175
episodes.description: Chopper climbs "Giant Jack" to get to the Upper Ruins. There, he encounters the priest Ohm, who cries about the fragility of humans.

episodes.name: Episode 183
episodes.description: Eneru burns Luffy's body with his scalding hot trident. Luffy comes up with an idea after struggling to fight against a foe who can read his moves.

episodes.name: Episode 179
episodes.description: Eneru destroys the Upper Ruins. Luffy and Aisa get left behind inside the python. Zoro and the others assemble in Shandora where Eneru awaits.

episodes.name: Episode 184
episodes.description: Eneru gets back up and seals Luffy's arm inside a giant chunk of gold. Luffy falls, gold and all, from high in the sky on the flying ark.

episodes.name: Episode 180
episodes.description: Ganfor flies into a rage after Eneru reveals his plans for the people of Skypiea. Wyper uses a special stone on Eneru to drain his energy.

episodes.name: Episode 187
episodes.description: Long ago, Wyper's ancestor Kalgara had a best friend. The friend, whose name was Montblanc Noland, met Kalgara after hearing the sound of a bell.

episodes.name: Episode 192
episodes.description: Luffy jumps into the thundercloud sphere to destroy it from within. Eneru tries to stop Luffy as he hurls himself toward the Golden Bell.

episodes.name: Episode 186
episodes.description: Luffy spots Robin as he climbs up Giant Jack. Immediately after their brief reunion, he leaves to continue running up the beanstalk to face Eneru.

episodes.name: Episode 182
episodes.description: Luffy wastes no time starting a fight with Eneru. Eneru blasts Luffy with powerful attacks, but they have no effect since Luffy is made of rubber.

episodes.name: Episode 188
episodes.description: Noland tells Kalgara that his village can be saved. By making medicine to rid the village of disease, Noland cements his friendship with Kalgara.

episodes.name: Episode 189
episodes.description: Not realizing their true intentions, the Shandians cast out Noland and his crew for cutting down the trees that housed their ancestors' spirits.

episodes.name: Episode 174
episodes.description: Robin hurls her anger at Yama for his recklessness around the ruins. As she continues her search, she discovers more ruins below the clouds.

episodes.name: Episode 195
episodes.description: The Going Merry gets enveloped by a giant octopus as it falls down back to the Blue Sea. The sound of the Golden Bell bids the Straw Hats farewell.

episodes.name: Episode 194
episodes.description: The Straw Hats start preparing to leave Skypiea after obtaining various goods and treasures. Robin discovers a message left behind by Gol D. Roger.

episodes.name: Episode 193
episodes.description: The ringing of the Golden Bell can be heard throughout Skypiea and even reaches Cricket's ears. The fighting has ended. A great celebration begins.

episodes.name: Episode 185
episodes.description: While Nami desperately tries to dodge all of Eneru's attacks, Sanji and Usopp sneak aboard the Maxim to get back in the fight.

episodes.name: Episode 191
episodes.description: Wyper decides to help after learning that Noland's descendant has been searching for Shandora. Nami gives Luffy a lift and heads to the Golden Bell.

episodes.name: Episode 181
episodes.description: Zoro is defeated before he can even land a blow on Eneru. Luffy finally gets out from inside the python and discovers his fallen friends.

episodes.name: Episode 178
episodes.description: Zoro struggles to keep up against his opponent's shapeshifting sword. Eneru appears before Robin as she explores the ruins of Shandora.

episodes.name: Episode 101
episodes.description: A bounty hunter known as Scorpion finds Ace. When the two enter a fight, it soon becomes clear that Scorpion lied about defeating Blackbeard.

episodes.name: Episode 95
episodes.description: Ace fights Smoker. Luffy declines Ace’s offer to join the Whitebeard Pirates and says he will fight their captain to become the king of all pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 99
episodes.description: Ace helps himself to food and water from Camu and his band of fake rebels. Vivi decides to test if the fake rebels' hearts are in the right place.

episodes.name: Episode 121
episodes.description: Baroque Works infiltrators start up a fight between the two sides. When Vivi refuses to give up, Crocodile holds her over the edge of the palace.

episodes.name: Episode 107
episodes.description: Bon Clay masquerades as King Cobra and confesses to the people of Nanohana that he had been taking their rain. A guard aims his gun at Koza.

episodes.name: Episode 127
episodes.description: Chaka orders his men to throw down their weapons. Igaram has a young witness from Nanohana explain that an imposter was pretending to be Cobra.

episodes.name: Episode 109
episodes.description: Chopper draws Crocodile's attention by calling himself Mr. Prince. Sanji kicks a banana gator to get the key out of its stomach.

episodes.name: Episode 118
episodes.description: Crocodile reveals a sinister plan after hearing that Cobra does not know the location of Pluton. Nami starts to get the hang of Clima Tact.

episodes.name: Episode 111
episodes.description: Crocodile throws Luffy into a pit of quicksand. Vivi and the others cross the river and meet up with Karoo and the Supersonic Duck Squadron.

episodes.name: Episode 115
episodes.description: Despite receiving serious injuries, Usopp continues to stand up against Ms. Merry Christmas and Mr. 4 with Chopper. Sanji fights Bon Clay.

episodes.name: Episode 129
episodes.description: Hina attacks the Going Merry and Bon Clay's ship. Bon Clay comes up with a diversion. The Straw Hats and Vivi display their sign of their friendship.

episodes.name: Episode 130
episodes.description: Hina demonstrates a special skill. The citizens of Alabasta start to rebuild their country. A stowaway appears on the Going Merry.

episodes.name: Episode 126
episodes.description: In spite of everything, the fighting still continues. Luffy hits Crocodile with a powerful storm of punches. Vivi's voice rings out for all to hear.

episodes.name: Episode 106
episodes.description: Luffy and the others run from Smoker inside Raindinners and go straight into a cage. The time has come for Operation Utopia to begin.

episodes.name: Episode 124
episodes.description: Luffy challenges Crocodile to another battle. Everyone aside from Pell assembles at the clocktower with help from Tashigi and the Marines.

episodes.name: Episode 125
episodes.description: Luffy continues to fight Crocodile. Nami comes up with an idea to get Vivi up to the top of the clocktower to stop the cannon.

episodes.name: Episode 123
episodes.description: Luffy gets rehydrated. Crocodile's partnership with Ms. All Sunday comes to an end. Vivi realizes where the cannon could be hidden.

episodes.name: Episode 102
episodes.description: Luffy goes on another hallucinatory rampage and gets lost in the desert with Zoro and Chopper away from the rest of the crew.

episodes.name: Episode 93
episodes.description: Luffy runs off to find an eatery in Nanohana. Sanji volunteers to go shopping for Vivi. Chopper accidentally gets taken away in a supply wagon.

episodes.name: Episode 116
episodes.description: Mr. 1 and Ms. Doublefinger zero in on Zoro and Nami. Sanji spots a flaw in Bon Clay's fighting technique.

episodes.name: Episode 98
episodes.description: Nami and Vivi ride ahead as Luffy and the others follow them on foot. Ace gets separated from the group while Luffy goes wild after eating cactuses.

episodes.name: Episode 117
episodes.description: Nami goes up against Ms. Doublefinger with the new weapon that Usopp made for her. Crocodile asks King Cobra a question.

episodes.name: Episode 113
episodes.description: Sanji tells Usopp to help Chopper and runs to be at Vivi's side. Two members of the Supersonic Duck Squad save Vivi and Karoo from Bon Clay.

episodes.name: Episode 104
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and Vivi spend the night in Yuba at an inn. At a casino in Rainbase, Crocodile unveils Operation Utopia.

episodes.name: Episode 110
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and Vivi start to take off toward Alubarna atop a giant crab, but Luffy decides to stay behind to deal with Crocodile.

episodes.name: Episode 128
episodes.description: The Straw Hats bring the palace to life. Hina secures the harbor to catch the pirates. The fugitives take off on the Supersonic Duck Squadron.

episodes.name: Episode 94
episodes.description: The Straw Hats spot Tashigi and Smoker while looking for Luffy. Smoker chases Luffy after being blasted out of a restaurant with Ace.

episodes.name: Episode 97
episodes.description: The Straw Hats travel through the desert with Vivi and Ace. Luffy rescues a camel from a carnivorous plant after getting tricked by a flock of birds.

episodes.name: Episode 103
episodes.description: The enemy leaders assemble and head out to see Crocodile in Rainbase. The Straw Hats and Vivi arrive in Yuba and find it deserted.

episodes.name: Episode 112
episodes.description: The rebel army is on their way to Alubarna to confront the royal army. The Baroque Works agents see six cloaked figures heading their way.

episodes.name: Episode 108
episodes.description: The rebel army makes their way toward Alubarna. As Crocodile prepares to head to the capital himself, he receives a call from a Mr. Prince.

episodes.name: Episode 120
episodes.description: There is less than half an hour left until detonation. Koza realizes Crocodile's role in everything. Vivi and Koza order their armies to stand down.

episodes.name: Episode 114
episodes.description: Usopp and Chopper are in trouble; Mr. 4 hurls exploding baseballs at them as Ms. Merry Christmas maneuvers through tunnels in the sand.

episodes.name: Episode 105
episodes.description: Vivi decides to head straight to Rainbase. Upon their arrival, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker.

episodes.name: Episode 96
episodes.description: Vivi sends Karoo on a mission to deliver a letter to Alubarna. Ace suspects there must be more to Crocodile's plan than to just take over the kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 122
episodes.description: Vivi warns Zoro and the others about the threat in the plaza. Luffy faces Crocodile. Ms. All Sunday forces Cobra to guide her to a certain location.

episodes.name: Episode 100
episodes.description: Young Vivi and her friend Koza lead a group of kids called the Sand-Sand Clan. Koza gets injured while trying to protect Vivi from kidnappers.

episodes.name: Episode 119
episodes.description: Zoro realizes that trying to defeat Mr. 1 would be like trying to cut through steel. As their battle continues, Zoro remembers his teacher's story.

episodes.name: Deciding to Say Goodbye! Sanji and his Straw-Hat Bento!
episodes.description: A captured Brook hears all about Big Mom’s plans for the wedding. Weak from hunger, Luffy digs deep to fight his way back to the rendezvous point.

episodes.name: “I'll Wait Here!” Luffy vs. the Enraged Army!
episodes.description: Big Mom’s army finally starts to wear Luffy down. Nami is obstructed by two of Big Mom’s daughters, one of whom decides to punish Kingbaum.

episodes.name: Invading the Château! Reach the Road Poneglyph!
episodes.description: Brook finds the Ponegliffs in the castle, but they are heavily guarded. Chopper and Carrot struggle to fend off Brûlée’s gang in the Mirro-World.

episodes.name: The Château in Turmoil! Luffy, to the Rendezvous!
episodes.description: Chopper and Carrot manage to reunite with a member of their crew in the Mirro-World. Luffy must fight his way past Big Mom’s enormous son Cabaletta.

episodes.name: The History of the Left Eye! Pedro vs. Baron Tamago!
episodes.description: Chopper and Carrot search the Mirro-World for a mirror leading to Sanji. With the Ponegliffs within his reach, Brook boldly faces off against Big Mom.

episodes.name: A Fateful Confrontation! Luffy and Big Mom!
episodes.description: Luffy rejects Big Mom’s offer of freedom in exchange for forgetting about Sanji. Big Mom erupts in anger when Nami conveys a message to her from Lola.

episodes.name: To Reach Sanji! Luffy's Vengeful Hell-Bent Dash!
episodes.description: Luffy sprints through the castle in search of Sanji, mowing down all in his path. The apparently defeated Tamago transforms and comes at Pedro again.

episodes.name: The End of the Adventure! Sanji's Resolute Proposal!
episodes.description: Luffy takes on Big Mom’s army alone, intent on keeping his promise to Sanji. Meanwhile, Sanji opens up to Pudding after she shows him kindness.

episodes.name: Shout of the Soul! Brook and Pedro's Lightning Operation!
episodes.description: Pedro races around the castle as a decoy, giving Brook a chance to sneak into the treasure room. A fight soon breaks out between Brook and the guards.

episodes.name: The Undaunted Soul! Brook vs. Big Mom!
episodes.description: Pudding uses her Devil Fruit powers to edit Reiju’s memories. Big Mom’s homies prove overwhelmingly strong for Brook, but he refuses to give in.

episodes.name: Goodbye! Pudding's Tearful Determination!
episodes.description: Pudding visits Luffy and Nami and tells them she will not marry Sanji. Chopper and Carrot launch a counterattack against Brûlée and her lackeys.

episodes.name: Moist Cigarette! The Night Before Sanji's Wedding!
episodes.description: Sanji cooks for Pudding but her door doesn’t allow him into her room. He circles around to her veranda and ends up privy to a private conversation.

episodes.name: Sora's Wish! Germa's Failure, Sanji!
episodes.description: Sanji visits Reiju in the medical center and fills her in on her missing memories. Meanwhile, Jimbei helps Luffy and Nami break out of their cell.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.description: A dog swallows the key to the cage Luffy is inside. Mayor Boodle puts the wounded Zoro to sleep and shares the story of Chouchou the dog.

episodes.name: Episode 54
episodes.description: A little girl named Apis meets the Straw Hats after escaping from a Marine ship. Luffy and his crew decide to go on a detour to take her home.

episodes.name: Episode 53
episodes.description: A thunderstorm illuminates Logue Town. Smoker turns his attention to Luffy after capturing the Buggy Pirates and Alvida.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.description: After being beaten to a pulp by a chef named Sanji, Fullbody receives an urgent report: One of Krieg's men has escaped.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.description: After seeing Shanks stand up against the bandit leader Higuma, a young Luffy declares that he will one day become the king of all pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 41
episodes.description: Arlong forces Nami to choose between rejoining his crew or fighting to the last alongside her fellow villagers. Luffy regains consciousness.

episodes.name: Episode 36
episodes.description: Belle-Mère has enough money to pay for her own survival, but she confesses to Arlong that she has two daughters who she can't provide for.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.description: Boodle attempts to take on Buggy by himself, but Luffy stops the mayor from getting himself killed. Luffy inflates himself to deflect a Buggy Ball.

episodes.name: Episode 46
episodes.description: Buggy seethes with vengeance after his fight with Luffy. He gets into a scuffle with Gaimon on his island when he is mistaken for a poacher.

episodes.name: Episode 47
episodes.description: Buggy's crew gets captured by cannibals after holding a funeral for their fallen leader. Buggy wreaks havoc after becoming whole again.

episodes.name: Episode 37
episodes.description: Captain Nezumi arrives to confiscate Nami's stolen possessions. Nojiko tries to stop her furious sister from approaching Nezumi.

episodes.name: Episode 49
episodes.description: Captain Smoker comes to arrest Luffy as he tries to climb the execution scaffold. Zoro obtains two swords from a weapon seller.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.description: Captain Usopp takes aim at Luffy with his slingshot after leading his crew to confront a boat that bears Buggy's insignia.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.description: Coby and Luffy arrive in a town to recruit Zoro. Peering over a wall, they see a young girl and a man approach the captured bounty hunter.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.description: Django accidentally affects Luffy when he hypnotizes his underlings to unleash their ferocity. Luffy's crew struggles against the Black Cat Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 31
episodes.description: During their pursuit of Nami, Yosaku explains to Luffy and Sanji that Arlong is a powerful fishman. Nami, Zoro and the others arrive in Arlong Park.

episodes.name: Episode 57
episodes.description: Eric comes after the Going Merry. The dragon remembers the location of Lost Island. The Staw Hats arrive on an island that doesn't appear on any map.

episodes.name: Episode 43
episodes.description: Furious that Nami was used as a map-making tool, Luffy destroys the room she used to work in. Nezumi calls for a bounty to be put on Luffy's head.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.description: Gin brings a starving Krieg to Baratie. Sanji ignores the protestations of those around him and gives the infamous pirate some food.

episodes.name: Episode 26
episodes.description: Gin points a gun at Zeff and demands that Sanji disembark. As Pearl's punches land, Sanji starts to lose consciousness and remembers his past.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.description: Krieg demands the owner of the Baratie to hand over his old ship's log after learning that he is the legendary pirate Zeff.

episodes.name: Episode 28
episodes.description: Krieg has launched his deadly MH5 poison gas bomb. Luffy fearlessly dashes toward Krieg through a barrage of projectiles.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.description: Kuro's strength shows no signs of deterioration. Zoro and the Meowban Brothers continue their fight. Luffy wakes up after being stepped on by Nami.

episodes.name: Episode 32
episodes.description: Luffy and Sanji beat up Momoo the giant sea cow. Nami's adoptive older sister Nojiko helps Usopp. A tied-up Zoro throws himself into the water.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.description: Luffy and his crew decide to help Usopp. As they wait for the Black Cat Pirates on a hill, they realize that there is another way to come ashore.

episodes.name: Episode 52
episodes.description: Luffy climbs the scaffold and takes in the very last view the pirate king would have seen. Buggy appears and tries to execute Luffy on the scaffold.

episodes.name: Episode 61
episodes.description: Luffy fights Eric to protect Apis and her determination to save the dragons' nest. The Straw Hats head to a waterway that leads to the Grand Line.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.description: Luffy inadvertently saves Nami from her pursuers. Nami is told to blast Luffy with a Buggy Ball when she presents Luffy to Buggy.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.description: Luffy launches himself toward Krieg's crew. When Sanji and the crew of the Baratie prepare for battle, Pearl emerges from the sea.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.description: Luffy learns about Buggy's history with Shanks. Buggy hurls the upper half of his body toward Nami as she tries to get away with his treasure.

episodes.name: Episode 38
episodes.description: Luffy punches Arlong and sends him flying shortly after entering Arlong Park. Arlong picks Luffy up and throws him into the sea.

episodes.name: Episode 42
episodes.description: Luffy puts a set of Arlong's regenerating teeth into his own mouth and bites back. Arlong goes into the sea to perform a special attack.

episodes.name: Episode 30
episodes.description: Luffy recruits Sanji to join his crew, but Sanji is reluctant to leave the restaurant. The other cooks put on an act to help Sanji make up his mind.

episodes.name: Episode 34
episodes.description: Luffy refuses to believe that Nami would kill Usopp. Nami's arrival triggers a tense situation between Zoro and Sanji. Luffy suddenly goes to sleep.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.description: Luffy throws a punch toward Kuro. Usopp orders his young crew members to protect Kaya. Kuro reveals the plan he set in motion years ago.

episodes.name: Episode 60
episodes.description: Luffy throws back the harpoon Nelson shot at the dragon. The sky fills with other dragons as their nest emerges for the first time in a millennium.

episodes.name: Episode 27
episodes.description: Luffy tries to sink the Baratie in order to take the objective away from Krieg. Gin steps in as Pearl charges toward Sanji and Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 59
episodes.description: Marine vessels surround the Going Merry. Eric earns the ire of Nelson when he betrays him by taking off with Apis and the dragon.

episodes.name: Episode 48
episodes.description: Nami, Usopp, Sanji and Zoro head into Logue Town to shop for various things. Luffy goes straight to the scaffold where Gold Roger was executed.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.description: No one believes Usopp when he tries to warn the villagers that pirates are coming. Usopp lies about telling the truth and prepares to face the enemy.

episodes.name: Episode 40
episodes.description: Sanji dives into the water to find that Luffy is already receiving help. Kuroobi takes the opportunity to strike as Sanji lets his guard down.

episodes.name: Episode 51
episodes.description: Sanji enters a cooking contest against Carmen, a woman who strives to become the best chef in all of East Blue.

episodes.name: Episode 55
episodes.description: The Going Merry escapes a Calm Belt on a Sea King's sneeze and arrives at Warship Island, where the descendants of Lost Island live.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates paint their very own pirate insignia aboard the Going Merry. The crew meets a pirate named Gaimon on a legendary island.

episodes.name: Episode 56
episodes.description: The Straw Hats help Apis escort an old dragon down a mountain in order to take him back home to Lost Island.

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.description: The battle between Luffy and Krieg rages on. Luffy lands punch after punch on Krieg's armor to get through his defenses.

episodes.name: Episode 45
episodes.description: The bounty on Luffy is worth a whopping 30 million berries. Kaya is delighted to spot Usopp's head in Luffy's wanted ad. Shanks receives news.

episodes.name: Episode 58
episodes.description: The crew only finds ruins on the island. The dragon remembers the real location of its home. Zoro deals with Eric while the others escort the dragon.

episodes.name: Episode 44
episodes.description: The islanders celebrate. Luffy gobbles up a storm. Nami pays her respects to Belle-Mère. Dr. Nako stitches Zoro up and removes Nami's tattoo.

episodes.name: Episode 50
episodes.description: Usopp faces bounty hunter Daddy Masterson in a duel after losing out on buying a pair of sniper goggles because of his daughter.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.description: Usopp is driven away from Kaya's mansion by her butler Klahadore. Luffy and Usopp witness two men discussing a nefarious plan.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.description: Usopp launches an explosive attack against Django as Luffy puts a dent in Kuro's plans. Kaya gives Luffy and his crew a ship to call their own.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.description: Usopp's crew decides to stand their ground and fight in order to live. Kuro prepares to sacrifice his men in order to attack Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.description: Young Monkey D. Luffy, a pirate himself, runs afoul of other pirates when they attack a cruise ship. Luckily, Luffy has the power of rubber.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.description: Young Zoro meets Kuina, his dojo master's daughter. They both swear to become the strongest sword fighter in the world.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.description: Zoro and Luffy work together to defeat Morgan as a team. Despite his relationship with Luffy and Zoro, Coby wishes to join the Marines.

episodes.name: Episode 35
episodes.description: Zoro and the others listen as Nojiko talks about the past. While growing up under Belle-Mère's care, Nami dreamt of drawing a map of the world.

episodes.name: Episode 33
episodes.description: Zoro heads to rescue Usopp from Choo. Nami confirms her intention to buy her home village after stabbing Usopp to avoid suspicion.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.description: Zoro spots the world's strongest swordsman and challenges him to a duel. Mihawk accepts the challenge — using only a dagger.

episodes.name: Episode 39
episodes.description: Zoro struggles to remain standing as the wound he sustained earlier from Mihawk holds him back. Genzo tries to free Luffy's legs from the rock.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.description: Zoro's old friend recovers from scurvy with lime. The Straw Hats head to the restaurant ship Baratie after realizing the importance of having a cook.

episodes.name: The Spear of Elbaf! Onslaught! The Flying Big Mom!
episodes.description: A frenzied Big Mom causes havoc in the city as she hungers for wedding cake. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang head toward the Seducing Woods.

episodes.name: The Evil Army! Transform! Germa 66!
episodes.description: Bege performs an impressive transformation to help protect the alliance from the incoming onslaught. The Vinsmoke family decides to join the fight.

episodes.name: Escape From the Tea Party! Luffy vs. Big Mom!
episodes.description: Bege's group begins the escape plan while Germa 66 repels Big Mom's forces, but a powerful attack on Reiju compels Luffy and Sanji to intervene.

episodes.name: Mom’s Secret! The Giant’s Island Elbaf and a Little Monster!
episodes.description: Big Mom recalls her past, when she was a five-year-old named Charlotte Linlin who was abandoned by her parents and taken in by Mother Carmel.

episodes.name: Pudding’s Determination! Ablaze! The Seducing Woods!
episodes.description: Big Mom's familiar-looking attack surprises Luffy. Aboard King Baum, Nami encourages him to speed up as Big Mom follows dangerously close behind.

episodes.name: The Castle Collapses! The Straw Hat’s Great Escape Begins!
episodes.description: Chaos ensues as the crumbling château falls on the city below and Luffy's group attempts an escape, prompting a sweet intervention from Streusen.

episodes.name: A Coincidental Reunion! Sanji and the Lovestruck Evil Pudding!
episodes.description: Chopper and Brook arrive back at the Sunny but find Katakuri and Perospero on board. Nami uses Zeus to hit Big Mom with a massively powerful strike.

episodes.name: A Lightning Counterattack! Nami and Zeus the Thundercloud!
episodes.description: Luffy's group fights through the shifting Seducing Woods on the way to the Sunny while Chopper and Brook reach the place they left the Shark Submerge.

episodes.name: Save the Sunny! Fighting Bravely! Chopper and Brook!
episodes.description: Pudding uses her Devil Fruit ability to hold off the tree homies' attacks. Chopper and Brook struggle against the Big Mom Pirates aboard the Sunny.

episodes.name: The Launcher Blasts! The Moment of Big Mom’s Assassination!
episodes.description: Streusen finds a dejected Linlin, and the two begin building their perfect world. In the present, the assassination attempt on Big Mom continues.

episodes.name: The Birth of Mom! The Day That Carmel Vanished!
episodes.description: Struggling to constrain Linlin's destructive rampage, Mother Carmel and the giants buckle to her demands and try to deal with the damage she caused.

episodes.name: Cutting the Father-Son Relationship! Sanji and Judge!
episodes.description: While Bege, the Straw Hats and the others take refuge in the fortress, Big Mom regains her senses and begins a pounding assault on their position.

episodes.name: The Execution Begins! Luffy’s Allied Forces Are Annihilated?!
episodes.description: While Caesar Clown continues the desperate flying escape, Big Mom attempts to finish off Judge. Her children overwhelm the alliance on the ground.

episodes.name: Before the Dawn! Pedro, the Captain of the Guardians!
episodes.description: With battleships approaching from the sea, Big Mom on land, and Katakuri and Perospero on the Sunny, the Straw Hats face impending doom.

episodes.name: Episode 420
episodes.description: A girl named Soran helps Robin in Tequila Wolf, where convicts have been building a bridge for the past 700 years. Usopp finds himself in a forest.

episodes.name: Episode 411
episodes.description: Hancock and her crew return to the Island of Women. In spite of her awful personality, the Love-Love Fruit user is beloved by her subjects.

episodes.name: Episode 417
episodes.description: Hancock has fallen ill. When Luffy asks her to take him to Impel Down so that he can rescue Ace, Hancock blushes and agrees to help him.

episodes.name: Episode 414
episodes.description: Hancock orders her sisters to crush Luffy. Marigold uses her venom to weaken Luffy and sends him flying toward the spiked pit around the arena.

episodes.name: Episode 418
episodes.description: Hancock's imagination runs wild as she spends time alone with Luffy. Nami has been transported to Weatheria, while Franky has wound up in Baldimore.

episodes.name: Episode 413
episodes.description: Hancock's sisters Sandersonia and Marigold have turned into giant serpents. Luffy refuses to be publicly executed and prepares to fight.

episodes.name: Episode 416
episodes.description: Having been won over by Luffy, Hancock decides to give him a ride to the Sabaody Archipelago and allows him to attend a celebratory banquet.

episodes.name: Episode 408
episodes.description: Kuma has sent Luffy flying across the sky with his Devil Fruit powers. After falling asleep in midair, Luffy wakes up in the middle of a jungle.

episodes.name: Episode 415
episodes.description: Luffy asks Hancock to return Margaret and the others back to normal. Hancock is surprised to see him give up his own ambitions to save others.

episodes.name: Episode 412
episodes.description: Luffy catches a glimpse of Hancock's back. Hancock shoots her Love-Love Beam at Luffy for seeing something he should never have seen.

episodes.name: Episode 409
episodes.description: Luffy has been imprisoned in Amazon Lily, an island of only women. The warriors prepare to shoot Luffy to uphold their centuries old ban against men.

episodes.name: Episode 421
episodes.description: Perona has been sent to the ruins of the fallen Muggy Kingdom, where she unexpectedly finds Zoro. Brook lands in Hungeria.

episodes.name: Episode 410
episodes.description: The Island of Women is surrounded by a Calm Belt, and Hancock's pirate ship is the only ship they have. Luffy takes to the open sea with just a raft.

episodes.name: Episode 419
episodes.description: The rest of the Straw Hats that were sent flying by Kuma are on the move. Chopper has landed in Birdie Kingdom. Sanji wakes up on a pink island.

episodes.name: An Explosive Situation! Luffy vs. Fake Luffy!
episodes.description: A group of impostors is impersonating the Straw Hat Pirates. Chopper mistakes the group for his own, while Luffy encounters a fake version of himself.

episodes.name: The Straw Hats Stunned! The New Fleet Admiral of the Navy!
episodes.description: A party is held at the palace to thank the Straw Hats. Later, King Neptune tells Robin that Shirahoshi is Poseidon, one of the three Ancient Weapons.

episodes.name: Something Has Happened to Hordy! The True Power of the Evil Drug!
episodes.description: After capturing King Neptune, Hody heads to Gyoncorde Plaza to execute him. Excited, the New Fishman Pirates once again head to the plaza.

episodes.name: Undersea Volcanic Eruption! Drifting to the Fishman Island!
episodes.description: An ominous ghost ship called the Flying Dutchman appears and blocks the path of the Thousand Sunny. Luffy arrives just in time with the Kraken in tow.

episodes.name: Landing at the Fishman Island! Beautiful Mermaids!
episodes.description: Approaching the island, the Straw Hats are surrounded by the New Fishman Pirates. In their battle to pass through, many of the group become separated.

episodes.name: The Battle Is On! Show Them What You Got From Training!
episodes.description: Brook escapes the venue and rushes to the Thousand Sunny. While the battle rages, Sentomaru and the Pacifista arrive at Fake Luffy's gathering point.

episodes.name: Luffy’s All-Out Attack! Red Hawk Blasts!
episodes.description: Brook faces off against Zeo using the Soul Solid cane sword he had sharpened by the Longarm tribe. Meanwhile, Usopp makes progress fighting Daruma.

episodes.name: Deadly Combat Under the Sea! The Demon of the Ocean Strikes!
episodes.description: Caribou finds himself stranded on the Thousand Sunny after an attack. When the fearsome Kraken later appears, Luffy decides to try and tame it.

episodes.name: The Ryugu Palace! Taken by the Shark That They Saved!
episodes.description: Caribou is freed from the barrel Franky put him in. After hearing that Fishman Island may be destroyed, Luffy and the gang are pursued by Fukaboshi

episodes.name: The Death of the Hero! A Shocking Truth of Tiger!
episodes.description: Deciding to take Koala back to her home, the Sun Pirates finally reach their destination. On the way back, Tiger finds himself surrounded by Marines.

episodes.name: Luffy Loses the Fight?! Hordy’s Long-Awaited Revenge!
episodes.description: Decken loses consciousness as the Devil Fruit wears off. The Noah begins to fall towards the island as Fukaboshi stops Luffy from destroying the ship.

episodes.name: Hordy’s Onslaught! The Retaliatory Plan Set Into Motion!
episodes.description: Decken teams up with the New Fishman Pirates and rushes to the palace. Meanwhile, Robin fends off the palace knights as she heads for the Sea Forest.

episodes.name: Hurry Up, Luffy! Shirahoshi’s Life in Jeopardy!
episodes.description: Decken uses Devil Fruit to aim the Noah towards Shirahoshi. To protect the residents, Shirahoshi leaves the island in a bid to draw the ship away.

episodes.name: The Fishman Island Will Be Annihilated?! Sharley’s Prophecy!
episodes.description: Despite losing massive amounts of blood and collapsing, Sanji miraculously survives. Later, Camie introduces Luffy and the gang to Madam Shyarly.

episodes.name: Big Guns Assembled! The Danger of the Fake Straw Hats!
episodes.description: Fake Luffy assembles a group to exact his revenge as Luffy himself shows up at their gathering. Meanwhile, the Marines lay siege to Brook's concert.

episodes.name: A Coward and a Crybaby! The Princess in the Hard Shell Tower!
episodes.description: Flying Dutchman captain Vander Decken IX schemes to marry Shirahoshi. Meanwhile, Luffy accidentally wanders into the highly sensitive princess's room.

episodes.name: The Ryugu Palace in Shock! The Kidnapping of Shirahoshi!
episodes.description: Franky visits Tom's younger brother Den to look for the Thousand Sunny. It appears to have drifted to the Sea Forest, a graveyard for lost vessels.

episodes.name: The Haunting Ties! Nami and the Fishman Pirates!
episodes.description: Fukaboshi confronts the pirates scattered across the area. Discovering that pictures of his mother are being defiled, he erupts into a seething rage.

episodes.name: Deadly Attacks One After Another! Zoro and Sanji Join the Battle!
episodes.description: Half of the 100,000 New Fishman Pirates fall. Luffy hits the others with his Gum-Gum Giant Pistol while Zoro, Robin and Brook join in the fighting.

episodes.name: The Battle in Ryugu Palace! Zoro vs. Hordy!
episodes.description: Hody and the group break into the palace while Decken chases after the princess. Hody declares that his pirates will continue Arlong's will.

episodes.name: Shirahoshi’s Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
episodes.description: Hody reveals that he shot Otohime at Gyoncorde Plaza 10 years ago. Shirahoshi tells him that she already learned this from Megalo, who witnessed it.

episodes.name: Kizaru Appears! A Trap To Catch Tiger!
episodes.description: Jimbei continues the story. Fisher Tiger attacks Mary Geoise, home to the World Nobles. He joins the Sun Pirates, who end up taking a girl onboard.

episodes.name: Shaking Fishman Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
episodes.description: Jimbei receives an offer from the World Government and joins the Shichibukai. The pirates return to Fishman Island. A World Noble soon arrives.

episodes.name: She Loves Sweets! Big Mom of the Four Emperors!
episodes.description: Luffy and the gang go to retrieve the treasure Caribou stole from the palace. On the way back, they run into Pekoms and Tamago of the Big Mom Pirates.

episodes.name: Excitement Blow-Out! Sanji’s Life Under Threat!
episodes.description: Luffy and the gang rescue Camie and arrive at Mermaid Cove. Sanji is delighted by the beautiful mermaids — until the Neptune Brothers appear.

episodes.name: A Big Clash! The Straw Hats vs. a Hundred Thousand Enemies!
episodes.description: Luffy arrives at the plaza just as Hody is about to kill Neptune. The Straw Hats assemble and attack using the strategy that Jimbei taught them.

episodes.name: The Noah Closing In! The Fishman Island Facing Destruction!
episodes.description: Luffy uses his Haki to overpower Hody. However, the Noah, a giant ship built by the residents centuries ago, now threatens to collide with the island.

episodes.name: Coming to an End! The Final Decisive Battle Against Hordy!
episodes.description: Luffy's Gum-Gum Jet Bazooka isn’t enough to take down Hody. When his second Red Hawk attack also proves to be ineffective, Luffy must dig even deeper.

episodes.name: A Hero Who Freed the Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
episodes.description: Luffy, Nami, Sanji and Chopper arrive at the Sea Forest. Jimbei then tells the story of the two individuals who worked to change the island's history.

episodes.name: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down the Future!
episodes.description: Otohime accompanies the World Noble back to the heavens. She safely returns one week later with a letter encouraging the Fishmen to relocate there.

episodes.name: Back to the Present! Hordy Makes a Move!
episodes.description: Otohime is attacked by an unknown perpetrator. Hody declares the assailant was a human, and Neptune heads to Hard-Shell Tower in a fit of rage.

episodes.name: The King of the Fishman Island! Neptune, the God of the Sea!
episodes.description: Pursued by the New Fishman Pirates, Gyro and crew are forced to back down. An enraged Captain Hody Jones chases after them the instant they escape.

episodes.name: Back to Zero! Earnest Wishes for Luffy!
episodes.description: Raised on Fishman Island, Hody is taught to believe that humans are inferior. Arlong and the death of Fisher Tiger serve to fuel his hatred even more.

episodes.name: Everyone Together! Luffy, Setting Out for the New World!
episodes.description: Rayleigh, Perona and Hancock block the Marines chasing after the Straw Hat Pirates. With the whole crew back together, they embark for Fishman Island.

episodes.name: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbei vs. Arlong!
episodes.description: Refusing to accept human blood, Fisher Tiger is in trouble. Still holding a grudge against humans, Arlong decides to strike but is met by Borsalino.

episodes.name: The Battle Is On! At Conchcorde Plaza!
episodes.description: Rejected by Shirahoshi, Decken comes up with a plan to destroy everything. Hody arrives at Gyoncorde Plaza to find Neptune's forces waiting for him.

episodes.name: The Navy Has Set Out! The Straw Hats in Danger!
episodes.description: Robin visits the Thousand Sunny, which has been fully coated for voyage. She then discovers that Brook has found a burgeoning career as a rock star.

episodes.name: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats vs. the New Fishman Pirates!
episodes.description: Sanji and Wadatsumi face off on the island. Brook and Franky team up to take on Zeo and Ikaros, while Usopp and Chopper hold back Daruma and Dosun.

episodes.name: A Surprising Fact! The Man Who Guarded the Sunny!
episodes.description: Sentomaru reports back to base. Rayleigh recalls the first time he met Gol D. Roger, and Franky reveals who has been looking after the Thousand Sunny.

episodes.name: A Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind the Assassination of Otohime!
episodes.description: Shirahoshi and Jimbei ride Megalo to Gyoncorde Plaza but fall into a trap. Meanwhile, Fukatoshi and the gang join Neptune in the ensuing battle there.

episodes.name: Keep Shirahoshi Safe! Decken Close Behind!
episodes.description: Shirahoshi and Luffy run into Sanji and Chopper while heading towards the Sea Forest. Luffy is captured while trying to rescue the princess.

episodes.name: The Fierce Fight Begins! Luffy vs. Hordy!
episodes.description: Shirahoshi tries to get as far out into the ocean as possible. Just as Hody catches up with Shirahoshi, Luffy arrives on the back of Fukaboshi.

episodes.name: Finally Time To Go! Goodbye, Fishman Island!
episodes.description: Shyarly's prediction may end up coming true. To prevent this, the Straw Hat Pirates must set sail. In the port, everyone feels a tinge of sadness.

episodes.name: Many Problems Lie Ahead! A Trap Awaiting in the New World!
episodes.description: Sun Pirate leader Jimbei tells Neptune he wants to separate the group from the Big Mom Pirates. Neptune expresses his thoughts on the Straw Hats.

episodes.name: It’s an Emergency! The Ryugu Palace Is Occupied!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats are unable to dispel the mermaids' suspicions. Later, the princess's soldiers approach Nami, Usopp and Brook with spears at the ready.

episodes.name: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats debut two new weapons during the battle. Despite being attacked by Daruma, Frankie combines the weapons to make a giant robot.

episodes.name: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons of the Sunny!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats gradually take down the New Fishman Pirates. Joined by Nami, Usopp and Chopper, Franky shows off a new weapon on the Thousand Sunny.

episodes.name: Stop, Noah! Desperate Elephant Gatling!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats use their special moves to wipe out the New Fishman Pirates. With no time to spare, the Noah draws closer to Fishman Village.

episodes.name: To the New World! Heading for the Ultimate Sea!
episodes.description: The Thousand Sunny heads into the New World. While everyone is enjoying the smooth voyage, the ship is suddenly sucked into a White Storm.

episodes.name: Lost in the Deep Sea! The Straw Hats Get Separated!
episodes.description: The group shows off their new skills while fighting the Kraken. After Luffy pummels the creature with his fists, a current sucks them into the sea.

episodes.name: The Secret Revealed! The Truth About the Ancient Weapon!
episodes.description: The humans are freed from the New Fishman Pirates. Neptune invites the remaining pirates to the island but the Straw Hats are already leaving.

episodes.name: The Kingdom in Shock! An Order To Execute Neptune Issued!
episodes.description: The pirates force citizens to defile Otohime's photo. Hody delivers a speech from the palace, declaring that he will now lead the Ryugu Kingdom.

episodes.name: The Beginning of the New Chapter! The Straw Hats Reunited!
episodes.description: Two years have passed since the Battle of Marineford. After much time training, Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates return to the Sabaody Archipelago.

episodes.name: A Shocking Fact! The True Identity of Hordy!
episodes.description: Wadatsumi inflates himself to threaten Sanji. Robin releases the human pirates that were enslaved while news of the falling Noah reaches Neptune.

episodes.name: To the Future! The Path to the Sun!
episodes.description: When the Sea Kings stop the Noah and save the island, Shirohoshi discovers that she is one of them. They then take the Noah down to the Sea Forest.

episodes.name: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy vs. Jimbei!
episodes.description: Zoro and others are tortured while Brook uses his new skill to sneak into the palace. At the Sea Forest, Luffy and Jimbei engage in an intense battle.

episodes.name: The Straw Hats Defeated?! Hordy Gains Control of the Ryugu Palace!
episodes.description: Zoro is attacked by the New Fishman Pirates. Deciding to forfeit the palace, Neptune tries to escape with his men by using his Ultramarine attack.

episodes.name: Episode 136
episodes.description: A herd of goats descends upon the Straw Hats on an island. Luffy and the others agree to do chores to make up for making their master Zenny faint.

episodes.name: Episode 141
episodes.description: Ape's Concert is a confusing, maze-like place. Luffy and the others decide to meet up with the Pumpkin Pirates to find a way to escape.

episodes.name: Episode 134
episodes.description: Luffy and the others visit an island famous for its 400-year-old fireworks festival. Usopp goes to acquire some gunpowder from a firework maker.

episodes.name: Episode 132
episodes.description: Luffy fishes a lost salesman out of the sea. After obtaining high quality paper from him, Nami gets to work on mapping out their voyage thus far.

episodes.name: Episode 143
episodes.description: Luffy interferes to stop Wetton from hauling the treasure out of Ape's Concert. Feeling cornered, Wetton blows up the Rainbow Tower.

episodes.name: Episode 140
episodes.description: On the other side of the Rainbow Mist is a ship graveyard known as Ape's Concert. When spooky ghosts suddenly appear, Luffy and the others fight back.

episodes.name: Episode 131
episodes.description: The Straw Hats find an island full of edible fruits. Staying behind to watch the ship, Chopper reminisces about the first time he made a Rumble Ball.

episodes.name: Episode 133
episodes.description: The Straw Hats rescue Tajio, a cook's apprentice who fell overboard from a Marine ship. After hearing about his dreams, Sanji decides to help him out.

episodes.name: Episode 139
episodes.description: The Straw Hats shake off the Marines and arrive on the island of Luluka. There, they meet a scientist named Henzo who is researching the Rainbow Mist.

episodes.name: Episode 142
episodes.description: The leader of the Pumpkin Pirates shakes off his doubts about Henzo. Outside of the mist, Nami and the others attempt to rescue their friends.

episodes.name: Episode 138
episodes.description: Zenny and the island goats furiously fight back against the Marines who came to his island to take his money.

episodes.name: Episode 137
episodes.description: Zenny reveals that he used to lend money to pirates. Luffy tells Zenny that his age shouldn't hold him back from his dream of heading out to sea.

episodes.name: Episode 135
episodes.description: Zoro meets Yosaku and Johnny for the first time before he became a pirate. The two bounty hunters stand up to challenge a bandit named Dick.

episodes.name: The Capital City Falls?! Big Mom and Jinbe!
episodes.description: A hungry Big Mom rampages through a city and eats everything in sight. Her son Moscato desperately tries to calm her, but his pleas fall on deaf ears.

episodes.name: A Massive Attack! Mom’s Hunger Pangs!
episodes.description: Germa 66 shows its strength by ending a two-year war in four hours. The Straw Hats encounter an aggressive obstacle en route to Whole Cake Island.

episodes.name: The Emperor’s Castle! Arriving at Whole Cake Island!
episodes.description: Jimbei decides that it is time to leave the Big Mom Pirates and join Luffy’s crew. Big Mom says he is free to go — if he is willing to lose something.

episodes.name: A Mysterious Forest Full of Candies! Luffy vs. Luffy?!
episodes.description: Luffy and the crew finally reach Whole Cake Island. They chase a fleeing Sanji into a forest, but the never-ending sweets prove to be distracting.

episodes.name: The Emperor’s Daughter! Sanji’s Fiancée Pudding!
episodes.description: Luffy and the group are surprised to learn that Pudding is Sanji’s fiancée. She then talks passionately about her first encounter with her betrothed.

episodes.name: Zero and Four! Encountering Germa 66!
episodes.description: Luffy devours the poisonous skin of a giant fish and falls deathly ill with no medicine onboard to save him. The Sunny enters Big Mom’s territory.

episodes.name: The Land of Souls! Mom’s Fatal Ability!
episodes.description: Luffy reunites with Nami and learns that they have been trapped by a woman named Brûlée, one of the daughters of Big Mom and a Devil Fruit user.

episodes.name: Mom’s Assassin! Luffy and the Seducing Woods!
episodes.description: Nami and her group are pursued by a deadly rabbit pirate. They decide to give up the search for Sanji, but the strange forest obstructs their escape.

episodes.name: A Giant Ambition! Big Mom and Caesar!
episodes.description: Pedro and Brook overhear some worrying information in Sweet City. Meanwhile, Pekoms is in danger as Bege holds him at gunpoint at the edge of a cliff.

episodes.name: A Battle Between Father and Son! Judge vs. Sanji!
episodes.description: Sanji continues to fight Judge while refusing to use his hands. His father quickly overpowers him with his incredible strength and inhumane tactics.

episodes.name: Sanji’s Homecoming! Into Big Mom’s Territory!
episodes.description: Sanji heads for Whole Cake Island aboard Big Mom’s flagship. His stance against the marriage briefly wavers when he sees a photo of his bride-to-be.

episodes.name: A Seafaring Kingdom! Germa’s King Judge!
episodes.description: Sanji is in a sour mood as he receives visits from Reiju and his father Judge. Still at the mercy of the forest's flora, Luffy struggles to escape.

episodes.name: A Deadly Poison Crisis! Luffy and Reiju!
episodes.description: Sanji’s older sister Reiju boards the Sunny. She immediately identifies what Luffy ate and treats him using a daring method that shocks the crew.

episodes.name: Totto Land! Emperor Big Mom Appears!
episodes.description: Unable to contain their excitement at finding a town made of chocolate, Luffy and Chopper get themselves into trouble by eating an entire café.

episodes.name: Episode 406
episodes.description: A summer festival is about to begin. Boss Luffy decides to participate in the Great Portable Shrine Race after hearing about it from Usopp.

episodes.name: Episode 407
episodes.description: Brook gets apprehended when he confronts the Thriller Company after getting his memories back. Boss Luffy learns the truth and heads to rescue Brook.

episodes.name: Episode 229
episodes.description: A train barrels straight toward the Going Merry. According to Kokoro and Chimney of Shift Station, the "sea train" travels from island to island.

episodes.name: Episode 230
episodes.description: After arriving in Water Seven, Luffy and the others take in the various things the city has to offer as they ride yagaras into the center of town.

episodes.name: Episode 244
episodes.description: CP9 had already infiltrated Galley-La Company five years ago. According to Lucci, a particular individual from Iceberg's past is still alive.

episodes.name: Episode 243
episodes.description: CP9 is after the blueprints to the ancient weapon Pluton. For generations, shipwrights had been passing down the knowledge in order to be prepared.

episodes.name: Episode 249
episodes.description: Eight years ago, Franky's battleships attacked a judicial ship. Cannonballs rain down on Tom and Iceberg when they try to stop the onslaught.

episodes.name: Episode 247
episodes.description: Even as he tearfully resists Franky's offer to dismantle the Going Merry, Usopp knows deep down that there is no hope left for his beloved ship.

episodes.name: Episode 232
episodes.description: Foreman Paulie uses his ropes to defeat the Franky Family members, but he tries to keep going and make off with the stolen money himself.

episodes.name: Episode 238
episodes.description: Franky can breathe fire as if he were a Devil Fruit user, but he is fine being submerged in water since he is actually a fist-launching cyborg.

episodes.name: Episode 251
episodes.description: Iceberg tells Nami what he knows about Robin after regaining consciousness: Robin wants to make sure the Straw Hats get off the island without her.

episodes.name: Episode 255
episodes.description: Knowing that going to Enies Lobby would be like declaring war on the World Government, Luffy and the others prepare to ride a prototype sea train.

episodes.name: Episode 260
episodes.description: Like peeling an onion with his superior knife skills, Sanji strips Wanze of his noodle wear. Franky demonstrates his ability to turn into a centaur.

episodes.name: Episode 246
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro are sent flying by Lucci, who turns out to be a Devil Fruit user. CP9 goes after Franky to get the ancient weapon's blueprints.

episodes.name: Episode 257
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro's powerful combined attack blows away nature's fury. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji and the others learn the truth about Robin from Nami.

episodes.name: Episode 231
episodes.description: Luffy and the others exchange their gold to get cash to repair the Going Merry. While trying to enter the shipyard, they meet a foreman named Kaku.

episodes.name: Episode 233
episodes.description: Luffy gets upset after hearing from Kaku that the condition of the Going Merry is beyond repair. Usopp and 200 million berries have gone missing.

episodes.name: Episode 242
episodes.description: Masked figures appear as an explosion goes off at Iceberg's mansion; they are members of the World Government's secret organization Cipher Pol 9.

episodes.name: Episode 253
episodes.description: Nami receives a love letter addressed to her at the station. In it, Sanji informs her that he has decided to board the last sea train.

episodes.name: Episode 262
episodes.description: Robin enters the car where Sanji and the others are, but she refuses to rejoin her friends. Sogeking activates a smoke bomb and runs off with Robin.

episodes.name: Episode 258
episodes.description: Sanji and Franky team up with Sogeking, a mysterious man from the island of snipers. Together, they trap the Marines in the back of the train.

episodes.name: Episode 261
episodes.description: T-Bone of the Marines and Zoro exchange blows in a clash between master swordsmen. Sanji teaches Wanze a lesson for insulting Robin.

episodes.name: Episode 245
episodes.description: The CP9 assassins are capable of turning themselves into living weapons. Unbelievably fast, they can even fly and slice down walls with a single kick.

episodes.name: Episode 248
episodes.description: The CP9 members show up at Franky's underground hideout. Farther in, they find the room where Franky spent countless hours with Iceberg and Tom.

episodes.name: Episode 256
episodes.description: The Franky Family hitches a ride on the Rocketman as the sea train goes full throttle, joined on board by Paulie and the other Galley-La foremen.

episodes.name: Episode 240
episodes.description: The Straw Hats have become wanted criminals within the city. Chopper picks up on a familiar scent while looking for Robin with Sanji.

episodes.name: Episode 237
episodes.description: The city is thrown into confusion after Mayor Iceberg is shot. While Luffy and Nami head to the shipyard, Sanji and Chopper go out to look for Robin.

episodes.name: Episode 254
episodes.description: The giant wave approaches while Luffy is stuck in between two buildings and Zoro is sticking out the top of a chimney. Nami reveals Robin's sacrifice.

episodes.name: Episode 252
episodes.description: The high tide will make it impossible to leave the island once the train headed to Enies Lobby takes off. Nami and the others rush to the station.

episodes.name: Episode 239
episodes.description: The townsfolk turn on the Straw Hats after learning about their connection to Robin. Luffy goes to the Galley-La HQ to find out what really happened.

episodes.name: Episode 250
episodes.description: Tom and his apprentices are arrested. To save Franky and Iceberg, Tom chooses to accept the capital punishment for building the Pirate King's ship.

episodes.name: Episode 263
episodes.description: Using his Devil Fruit abilities, Blueno strikes Sanji by catching him off guard. Sogeking's efforts amount to nothing as Robin leaves, yet again.

episodes.name: Episode 235
episodes.description: Usopp adamantly opposes Luffy's decision to replace the Going Merry with another ship, but Luffy has made up his mind as the ship's captain.

episodes.name: Episode 236
episodes.description: Usopp means serious business as he comes at Luffy with all that he's got. Amidst the explosive fight, tears stream down the Going Merry's face.

episodes.name: Episode 234
episodes.description: Usopp runs into trouble after trying to get back the stolen money by himself. Luffy and the others burn with anger after seeing their defeated friend.

episodes.name: Episode 259
episodes.description: Wanze, the culinary fighter of CP7, absorbs Sanji's kick with his combat clothes made of noodles. Franky fights Nero, a new member of CP9.

episodes.name: Episode 241
episodes.description: Zoro surmises that Robin means to strike again tonight. The Straw Hats must capture Robin in order to find out whether she is their friend or foe.

episodes.name: Episode 317
episodes.description: A young girl comes to ask the town hero for help. Touched by her determination, Luffy decides to look for her old yagara with Chopper.

episodes.name: Episode 325
episodes.description: Ace hunts down Teach for killing his crewmate, but Teach demonstrates his ability to control the most evil of all the Devil Fruit powers.

episodes.name: Episode 310
episodes.description: After sinking the Straw Hats' only means of escape, the Marines turn their cannons to the now thoroughly exhausted and immobile Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 319
episodes.description: Chimney introduces Sanji to a little eatery that has simple but delicious food. Amazed by the taste, Sanji sets out to discover the chef's secrets.

episodes.name: Episode 324
episodes.description: Following Iceberg's excellent suggestion, the Straw Hats agree to name their shiny new ship the Thousand Sunny as they set sail for new adventure.

episodes.name: Episode 316
episodes.description: Four pirates known as the Four Emperors make up one of the three great powers of the world. A meeting takes place between Shanks and Whitebeard.

episodes.name: Episode 321
episodes.description: Having set his heart on recruiting Franky as his new shipwright, Luffy heads off with the others to pick up both Franky and the Straw Hats' new ship.

episodes.name: Episode 312
episodes.description: Luffy and the others rejoice as the shipwrights of Galley-La arrive, but the Straw Hats must bid farewell to their dearest friend.

episodes.name: Episode 322
episodes.description: Luffy offers to return Franky's briefs in exchange for joining his crew, but Franky remains stubborn. Robin handles the delicate situation.

episodes.name: Episode 307
episodes.description: Nami and the others reunite with Robin after being rescued by Kokoro. They must now wait for Luffy, but most of Enies Lobby appears to be burning.

episodes.name: Episode 308
episodes.description: Sogeking and the others get the chance to tell Luffy that they are all safely back together, but 200 elite Marines move in to recapture Robin.

episodes.name: Episode 311
episodes.description: The Gates of Justice create whirlpools as they begin to close. The Straw Hats turn this to their advantage and speed away from the Marine fleet.

episodes.name: Episode 313
episodes.description: The Straw Hats catch up on some well-deserved rest at the Galley-La HQ. Vice Admiral Garp barges in to see Luffy, who has been asleep for days.

episodes.name: Episode 320
episodes.description: The three Galley-La foremen work hard to keep up as they help Franky and Iceberg build the Straw Hats' new ship at an incredible pace.

episodes.name: Episode 309
episodes.description: Usopp takes off his Sogeking mask to let Luffy hear his true voice. Emboldened by his words, Luffy focuses on winning to get back to his friends.

episodes.name: Episode 314
episodes.description: Vice Admiral Garp reveals the identity of Luffy's father, the world's most dangerous criminal and leader of the Revolutionary Army.

episodes.name: Episode 315
episodes.description: While technically enemies, Coby, Helmeppo and Luffy are still friends at heart. Coby declares that he will capture Luffy the next time they meet.

episodes.name: Episode 323
episodes.description: Zoro explains to Luffy that they can't allow Usopp to rejoin the Straw Hat Pirates so easily. Luffy waits for Usopp to show up, but he never does.

episodes.name: Episode 318
episodes.description: Zoro gets pestered by a pair of delinquents. When their beast of a mother takes him home, Zoro finds himself having to babysit their many siblings.

episodes.name: Sons' Cups! The Straw Hat Fleet is Formed!
episodes.description: Aboard the fleeing ship, the Straw Hats toast their victory with their new-found comrades. But Luffy is reluctant to enter their proposed pact.

episodes.name: Steady Progress! Luffy’s Army vs. Pica!
episodes.description: After ripping off Pica's arm, Chinjao, Elizabello II and the other fighters set upon his soldiers. Zoro stays to fight, allowing Luffy to push on.

episodes.name: The Last Light of Hope! The Secret of Our Commander!
episodes.description: Angry at being tricked, Trébol causes great destruction. Usopp asks Leo why he puts his faith in Thunder Soldier and gets a surprising response.

episodes.name: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
episodes.description: As Doflamingo's battle with Luffy and Law intensifies, he tells them what made him so hateful. Below, Riku and Fujitora declare their trust in Luffy.

episodes.name: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!
episodes.description: As block B's battle nears its end, Bellamy takes on Bartolomeo while Elizabello II continues to warm up, intent on unleashing his devastating punch.

episodes.name: The Last - and Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!
episodes.description: As the block D battle gets underway, the crowd shows its disdain for Rebecca. Back at their secret base, the Tontatta tribe prepares an attack.

episodes.name: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo creates a makeshift path for Luffy to continue on, while he and Robin stay to fight Gladius. Below, Sabo and Fujitora's battle intensifies.

episodes.name: A Horrible Past! The Secret of Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo finally delivers Zoro's message to Luffy, while Thunder Soldier recalls the horrific events that took place in Dressrosa 10 years ago.

episodes.name: The Most Violent Fighter! Logan vs. Rebecca!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo happily agrees to search for his hero Luffy. In the ring, Rebecca fights the formidable Rolling Logan as she desperately avoids his blows.

episodes.name: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherits Ace's Will!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo steps in at a critical moment for Bellamy. Searching for a way out of the colosseum, Luffy has an unexpected but useful encounter.

episodes.name: A United Front! Luffy's Breakthrough to the Victory!
episodes.description: Bellamy confronts Doflamingo about his attempt on his life. Below, the Corrida fighters join forces and allow Luffy to head for the palace.

episodes.name: Law Dies! Luffy's Raging Onslaught!
episodes.description: Burning with rage after being forced to fight Bellamy, Luffy heads for the palace summit. There, he sees Doflamingo standing over a defeated Law.

episodes.name: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!
episodes.description: Cavendish narrowly escapes danger with Bartolomeo's help. Overwhelmed, Gladius calls Dellinger for assistance, and a mysterious figure suddenly attacks.

episodes.name: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!
episodes.description: Cavendish protects a fallen Law on Flower Hill. Above, Luffy vows to put an end to Doflamingo once and for all by preparing a powerful attack.

episodes.name: Protect You to the End! Rebecca and the Toy Soldier!
episodes.description: Competitor Rebecca has flashbacks of her childhood as she walks out for her block D showdown. Below, prisoners tell Luffy why she is despised.

episodes.name: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!
episodes.description: Corazón feeds Law the devil fruit and entrusts the boy with delivering a vital message to the Marines. However, Law unwittingly makes a grave mistake.

episodes.name: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!
episodes.description: Diamante causes the ground to ripple as Kyros battles to keep him from Rebecca. Above, Luffy tries convincing Bellamy to give up his fight.

episodes.name: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
episodes.description: Diamante closes in on Rebecca at Flower Hill. Luffy and Law make it to her location, where she gives them the key to Law's handcuffs.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
episodes.description: Doflamingo and Law exchange more battle moves and hurtful memories. Meanwhile, the streets of Dressrosa are rife with chaos.

episodes.name: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
episodes.description: Doflamingo recalls the dark memories of his youth, when his father renounced the life of the nobles and they were tortured by town locals.

episodes.name: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!
episodes.description: Doflamingo shoots Law in front of the Straw Hats and a shocked crowd then frames him for disinformation. Out at sea, Big Mom sets upon the Sunny.

episodes.name: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!
episodes.description: Doflamingo tightens the screws on Dressrosa by shrinking the cage that grips the island. Luffy fights on and receives some unexpected assistance.

episodes.name: The 500 Million Berry Man! Target: Usoland!
episodes.description: Doflamingo's sorcery locks down the island. With everyone under his control, he reads out a hit list, which includes the Straw Hats and Riku's family.

episodes.name: Dragon Claw Strikes! Lucy's Intimidating Attack!
episodes.description: Fearing Trébol's power, Robin stops Leo running toward Sugar. At the colosseum, the fight intensifies, though Lucy's identity is in question.

episodes.name: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!
episodes.description: Finally reaching the palace summit, Luffy and Law square up to Doflamingo. Further down, the Corrida fighters battle on against the Donquixote family.

episodes.name: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!
episodes.description: Franky leads the emboldened Tontattas on to destroy the SMILE factory, but he collapses at the entrance due to his grueling fight with Señor Pink.

episodes.name: Shaking Heaven and Earth! Admiral Fujitora's Power!
episodes.description: Fujitora and Doflamingo flank Law, leaving him stuck between a rock and a hard place. Meanwhile, the Tontatta people declare war on a common enemy.

episodes.name: Luffy! An All-Out Leo Bazooka!
episodes.description: Gear Fourth's time limit is up before Luffy can finish off Doflamingo. To make matters worse, Jesus Burgess shows up with an agenda of his own.

episodes.name: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!
episodes.description: Going by the name of Lucy, Luffy enters a tense tournament waiting area. He's attacked and defends himself, but a guard tells him he is disqualified.

episodes.name: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy!
episodes.description: In a bid to capture Momonosuke, Giolla of the Donquixote family transforms the Thousand Sunny and its remaining crew into abstract art.

episodes.name: A Big Surprise! The True Identity of the Toy Soldier!
episodes.description: In the dungeons below the colosseum, gladiator Riku reveals his true identity. Back at the Tontatta base, Thunder Soldier does the same.

episodes.name: Barrier-Barrier! Homage Holy Fist Strikes!
episodes.description: Inspired by Luffy, Bartolomeo gives Gladius everything he's got. Robin escapes to Flower Hill with a split Cavendish-Hakuba, hoping to rescue Rebecca.

episodes.name: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!
episodes.description: It's crunch time at the Corrida Colosseum for Rebecca in the block D battle. She faces the notorious Suleiman, who possesses an evident advantage.

episodes.name: Men's Pride! Luffy vs. Fujitora, Head-to-Head!
episodes.description: Law and Sengoku share more revelations about Corazón. Fujitora uses a unique method to trap the pirates before Luffy engages him in battle.

episodes.name: The Fighting Fish Strike! Across the Deadly Iron Bridge!
episodes.description: Law and the others try crossing an iron bridge to deliver Caesar on time. But as they push on for Green Bit, some fighting fish get in their way.

episodes.name: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
episodes.description: Law recalls the picturesque town he grew up in before it was ravaged by sickness, and how Doflamingo took him in when he was only ten years old.

episodes.name: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
episodes.description: Law reveals more about his past as he recounts the compassion Corazón showed him. Doubling his efforts, he vows never to forget him and fights on.

episodes.name: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Law's injection shot is ineffective, and further attacks cost him an arm. Outside, Pica's increase in size presents Zoro with an even bigger problem.

episodes.name: Breaking through Enemy Lines! Luffy and Zoro Launch the Counter-Attack!
episodes.description: Law, Zoro and Luffy head back to the palace to face Doflamingo. But they have a bounty on their heads and reward-hungry pirates on their tails.

episodes.name: The Fierce Battle Coming to the End! Lucy vs. Chin Jao!
episodes.description: Luffy and Chinjao's explosive bout rages on as the latter explains more about his fateful encounter with Luffy's grandfather 30 years ago.

episodes.name: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!
episodes.description: Luffy and Law learn that Kelly Funk's shortcut is a trap when they come face to face with Doflamingo. Outside, Sabo's fight with Fujitora rages on.

episodes.name: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro must face off against Admiral Fujitora, but their battle comes to an abrupt end when Pica makes a destructive entrance.

episodes.name: A Moving Castle! The Top Executive Pica Rises Up!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro proceed up the palace but are held back by top Donquixote Pirate Pica. Elsewhere, Usopp and the Tontatta tribe make it to Sugar's chamber.

episodes.name: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!
episodes.description: Luffy appears in the nick of time to save Viola before he confronts Doflamingo. The two pirates exchange powerful blows one final time.

episodes.name: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!
episodes.description: Luffy ascends to the palace, helped by the now organized fighters. Back in the Corrida Colosseum dungeons, Kin'emon finds a long-lost samurai ally.

episodes.name: Luffy and the Gladiator of Fate - Rebecca!
episodes.description: Luffy becomes the winner of block C, but Cavendish is in no mood for celebrations. Bartolomeo reveals his admiration for the victorious Straw Hat.

episodes.name: The Bond Between Father and Daughter! Kyros and Rebecca!
episodes.description: Luffy dodges Marines as he tries to reunite Rebecca with Kyros. Fujitora arrives at an eastern port to face the Straw Hats and their Corrida allies.

episodes.name: Full of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!
episodes.description: Luffy encounters a mysterious man who fights with some swindlers. During the fray, someone — or something — steals one of Zoro's swords.

episodes.name: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl - Violet!
episodes.description: Luffy enters a fighting tournament after learning that Ace's flare-flare fruit is the prize. Nearby, a dancing girl captivates Sanji.

episodes.name: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Luffy fights in earnest to protect Law. During the battle, Trébol recalls the role he played in enabling Doflamingo to become so merciless.

episodes.name: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Luffy finally finds Zoro and Kin'emon. At the bridge, Law and Doflamingo's battle intensifies before reaching its conclusion outside the colosseum.

episodes.name: A State of Emergency! Rebecca Is Kidnapped!
episodes.description: Luffy heads to the palace after hearing about Kyros' letter to Rebecca. Elsewhere, the Marines close in on the Straw Hats.

episodes.name: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
episodes.description: Luffy struggles with Doflamingo's clone and Bellamy. On the roof above, Law recalls how Corazón planned to treat his illness with a devil fruit.

episodes.name: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy in Trouble!
episodes.description: Luffy takes down the giant who harmed his new friend the tamed bull. But his next opponent boasts a destructive punch and won't be so easily defeated.

episodes.name: Light and Shadow! Darkness behind Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Luffy's final opponent of the round holds a grudge against him that he knows nothing about. Outside, Franky learns a dark secret about the toys.

episodes.name: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!
episodes.description: Luffy's group defeats a wave of soldiers to reach the first level of the palace grounds. Meanwhile, Sabo tries to hold off Fujitora and his Marines.

episodes.name: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!
episodes.description: Luffy's identity comes to light and he ends up in a three-way battle in the wings. Bartolomeo's attitude is too much for one opponent, who attacks him.

episodes.name: Startling! The Big News Shakes Up the New World!
episodes.description: Luffy, Law and the Straw Hat Pirates head to Dressrosa to keep their bargain with Doflamingo, who insists he's got something that will interest Luffy.

episodes.name: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish of the White Horse!
episodes.description: Nami and Brook finally shake off Giolla to regain control of the Thousand Sunny. But a desperate escape by Law only serves to invite another attack.

episodes.name: Defeat Sugar! The Army of the Little People Charges!
