episodes.description: No matter how hard Zoro strikes, he can't overcome Pica. Meanwhile, Robin lures Trébol away so Leo can try dropping a fake grape in Sugar's bowl.

episodes.name: A Pirate Noble! Cavendish!
episodes.description: Pirate Prince Cavendish arrives at the colosseum and reveals his motives to Luffy. Later, Luffy meets a gladiator girl with whom he shares an enemy.

episodes.name: Making a Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland!
episodes.description: Pretending to be a descendant of the Tontatta tribe's legendary hero Noland, Usopp leads them on a rescue mission against the Donquixote Pirates.

episodes.name: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
episodes.description: Pursued by the revenge-thirsty colosseum fighters, Luffy heads for the palace. On the way, Law reveals why he swore to overthrow Doflamingo.

episodes.name: The Admiral's Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Rebecca announces her win to Lucy but notices something different. Meanwhile, Violet shows Luffy a secret way into the palace.

episodes.name: The Fire Fist Strikes! The Flare-Flare Fruit Power Returns!
episodes.description: Rebecca's memories of her father return as the battle for the flare-flare fruit reaches its explosive finale. Elsewhere, Usopp becomes a savior.

episodes.name: No Way Out! Admiral Fujitora's Ruthless Pursuit!
episodes.description: Refusing to let up, Fujitora goes after Luffy and his allies with a mass of sky rubble. But the people of Dressrosa haven't forgotten Luffy's heroics.

episodes.name: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!
episodes.description: Released from Doflamingo's control, Bellamy isn't ready to give up his fight with Luffy. The Corrida fighters start to gain the upper hand.

episodes.name: Trueno Bastardo! Kyros' Furious Strike!
episodes.description: Remembering the death of his wife and the suffering of Dressrosa, Kyros moves to conclude his battle against Diamante with an anger-filled strike.

episodes.name: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chin Jao!
episodes.description: Robbed of his helmet, Luffy hides his identity as he fights against a well-armed Jean. Back at the ship, Nami's group continues to deal with Giolla.

episodes.name: The Brothers' Bond! The Untold Story Behind Luffy and Sabo's Reunion!
episodes.description: Sabo reveals more of his past and how he came to compete for the flare-flare fruit. At his palace, King Riku has some surprising news for Rebecca.

episodes.name: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Sanji arrives just in time to save the crew on the Thousand Sunny. But it's not long before Fujitora and his Marines join the pursuit.

episodes.name: The Stratagem of the Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
episodes.description: Sanji hears some dark truths from Violet and urges Law to leave Green Bit. At the colosseum, Luffy gets dangerously close to revealing his power.

episodes.name: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro's Deadly Attack!
episodes.description: Several giant toy soldiers block Luffy's group as they head for the fourth level. At the SMILE factory, the captive Tontattas attempt an escape.

episodes.name: The Healing Princess! Save Mansherry!
episodes.description: Soldiers carry the fallen Donquixote members to the palace chapel. There, Jora pressures Princess Mansherry to make use of her healing powers.

episodes.name: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
episodes.description: Some fighters are ahead in the race for Doflamingo, but Luffy hears of a shortcut. Robin tries to deliver the key for Law's handcuffs – from above.

episodes.name: The Fateful Reunion! Bellamy the Hyena!
episodes.description: Still awaiting his turn to fight, Luffy runs into an old adversary. Zoro continues chasing his sword, and Law's group learns about Green Bit.

episodes.name: Fourth Gear! The Phenomenal Bounce-Man!
episodes.description: The Birdcage closes in as Zoro and the samurai head off to try and stop it. Luffy uses his Gear Fourth technique to take back the advantage.

episodes.name: To Be Free! Dressrosa's Delight!
episodes.description: The Birdcage vanishes, and Law helps a plummeting Luffy to a soft landing. Overcome with emotion, Gyats struggles to announce the victor.

episodes.name: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
episodes.description: The Corrida Colosseum fighters arrive on the scene determined to defeat Doflamingo — no matter how much Luffy insists he will do it.

episodes.name: The Final Round Starts! Diamante the Hero Shows Up!
episodes.description: The Corrida Colosseum final bout begins. The four block winners and Diamante stride out, but only one can claim the flare-flare fruit as their prize.

episodes.name: Explore! A Kingdom of Love and Passion - Dressrosa!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats arrive at Dressrosa to hand over Caesar and destroy the SMILE factory. They split up and Luffy's group encounters some living toys.

episodes.name: The Numerous Rivals Struggle Amongst Themselves! The Raging Monsters of the New World
episodes.description: The Straw Hats learn of their new bounties while sailing to Zo. Elsewhere out at sea, an imprisoned Doflamingo predicts dark days ahead.

episodes.name: Rebecca's Special Attack! Last-Ditch Sword Dance!
episodes.description: The Sunny crew heads for Zou, while Law goes to confront Doflamingo on the bridge. Meanwhile, Rebecca works her way through her opponents.

episodes.name: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!
episodes.description: The Tontattas are thankful to Franky for freeing them, but they're devastated when they can't track down their princess. Viola steps in to try and help.

episodes.name: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros and King Riku!
episodes.description: The battle between Usopp and Trébol rages on. Elsewhere, Thunder Soldier reveals more of his past and how he came to be King Riku's chief guard.

episodes.name: The End of the Match?! A Surprising Result of Block D!
episodes.description: The battle of block D reaches an unexpected climax brought about by Cavendish's alter ego. Back at the palace, Doflamingo hosts a dethroned Riku.

episodes.name: Sending a Shock Wave! The Worst Generation Goes Into Action!
episodes.description: The news of Dressrosa's liberation spreads, affecting crime syndicates and their weapons networks. But Fujitora's apology angers some top Marines.

episodes.name: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!
episodes.description: The notorious Bartolomeo emerges as the last block B fighter. Bellamy works his way through a number of opponents only to become a target to an alliance.

episodes.name: The Unheard-of! Admiral Fujitora’s Surprising Decision!
episodes.description: The people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to return to the throne. Admiral Fujitora and his Marines arrive at the scene with a message of their own.

episodes.name: A Massive Counterattack! Doflamingo’s Awakening!
episodes.description: The people of Dressrosa lose hope as the Birdcage bears down on them, but an inspiring speech from King Riku gives their morale a much-needed boost.

episodes.name: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage!
episodes.description: The people of Dressrosa, the Straw Hats and the fighters halt the encroaching Birdcage. Meanwhile, Doflamingo manipulates Rebecca into attacking Viola.

episodes.name: The Strongest Creature! One of the Four Emperors - Kaido, King of the Beasts!
episodes.description: The remaining Sunny crew finally shake off Big Mom, only to arrive at an unknown island. There, a mysterious foe appears and more turmoil unfolds.

episodes.name: The Devil's Trap! A Dressrosa Extermination Plan!
episodes.description: The vengeful pirates enter the factory but meet resistance from Diamante and Trébol. Back at the palace, there are two Doflamingos to deal with.

episodes.name: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!
episodes.description: Things go well for the fighters as Baby 5 mistakes Sai's threats for a marriage proposal, and Lao G's nifty moves are repelled, sending him plummeting.

episodes.name: The Rupture Human! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!
episodes.description: Thunder Soldier meets Gladius as he attempts to proceed through the palace. Luffy shows up, but it looks as though it's over for the nutcracker.

episodes.name: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night of Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Thunder Soldier recalls further atrocities and reveals the truth about the king. Meanwhile, the Donquixote family turns more fighters into toys.

episodes.name: The Operation Failed! Usoland the Hero Dies?!
episodes.description: Thunder Soldier recalls what happened to his wife and his leg 10 years ago. Meanwhile, Usopp's battle with Trébol takes a sticky turn.

episodes.name: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!
episodes.description: To stop his brother from escaping with the stolen devil fruit, Doflamingo activates the birdcage. Corazón makes a desperate bid to save Law.

episodes.name: Fujitora Takes Action! The Complete Siege of the Straw Hats!
episodes.description: Top-ranking Marines arrive on Dressrosa to question Fujitora about his lack of action. Meanwhile, rumors of a new princess excite the town.

episodes.name: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trebol!
episodes.description: Trébol has Luffy trapped in his sticky grasp. But he soon loses the upper hand when a string of insults from Law lures him into a trap.

episodes.name: Dashing onto the Scene! The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army - Sabo!
episodes.description: Usopp gives his new followers the order to destroy the SMILE factory. Nearby, Lucy reveals a close connection to Luffy.

episodes.name: The Legend is Back! Kyros' All-out Blow!
episodes.description: Usopp renders Sugar unconscious, triggering a transforming effect on all the living toys. Thunder Soldier, now back as Kyros, has a score to settle.

episodes.name: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!
episodes.description: Usopp runs from what he sees as a hopeless situation. But the unshakable self-belief of the Tontatta tribe spurs him to return and fight.

episodes.name: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Usopp uses an improvised catapult to stop a vengeful Sugar, but if he misses, Luffy and Law will be turned into toys.

episodes.name: Operation SOP Starts! Usoland Charges Forth!
episodes.description: Usopp's group and the Tontatta tribe are ready to commence their SOP battle strategy. Franky takes the front entrance, where Señor Pink confronts him.

episodes.name: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!
episodes.description: Viola informs King Riku of each battle status. Law fights on at the palace, determined to honor Corazón. Law tells Doflamingo a truth that shakes him.

episodes.name: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
episodes.description: Viola uses her powers of clairvoyance to locate the room where Princess Mansherry is being held captive. Meanwhile, Sugar regains consciousness.

episodes.name: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom!
episodes.description: Violet is deeply moved by Sanji's trust in her and finds it difficult to hand him over. Back at the Corrida Colosseum, Luffy can't wait to get going.

episodes.name: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!
episodes.description: While Luffy regains his strength, colosseum announcer Gyats gathers the fighters to stall Doflamingo, and Sabo takes on Burgess.

episodes.name: The Birth of the Legend! The Adventures of the Revolutionary Warrior Sabo!
episodes.description: While the Straw Hats recuperate, Sabo arrives and reveals his history with Luffy, how he survived and how he joined the Revolutionary Army.

episodes.name: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. the Straw Hats!
episodes.description: With Caesar's heart back in his possession, Doflamingo has a few things to say to Law. Meanwhile, Brook tries to lure Giolla into a trap.

episodes.name: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!
episodes.description: With a plan in place, Zoro enlists Orlumbus to propel him through the sky, so he can attempt a Sanzen Sekai sword technique on evil rock-giant Pica.

episodes.name: Dead or Alive! A Fateful Countdown!
episodes.description: With just sixty seconds before the town is destroyed and even less time left until Rebecca attacks Viola, Luffy must return before all is lost.

episodes.name: Tears of Miracles! Mansherry's Fight!
episodes.description: With the assistance of Mansherry's healing tears, Bartolomeo leads a resurgent group of Corrida fighters in an attempt to stop the Birdcage.

episodes.name: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!
episodes.description: With the princess rescued, the Donquixote family's backup plans for the SMILE factory look finished – unless Señor can defeat Franky outside.

episodes.name: Explore! Fairies' Island - Green Bit!
episodes.description: Zoro finally catches his sword's thief, who turns out to be from the Tontatta tribe. Meanwhile, Robin discovers more of the thieves on Green Bit.

episodes.name: So Long! Bellamy's Farewell Blow!
episodes.description: Zoro is victorious in his assault, while the Tontattas destroy the SMILE factory. But Doflamingo and his Birdcage still encase the island.

episodes.name: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!
episodes.description: Zoro must think fast to save King Riku and his followers from Pica. He desperately brainstorms strategies, hoping to hit on something useful.

episodes.name: Episode 496
episodes.description: Ace and Sabo have accepted Luffy as one of their own. The trio of boys heads into Goa Kingdom, where Sabo gets recognized by a man on the streets.

episodes.name: Episode 500
episodes.description: Ace and his brothers scavenge for the parts they need to repair their secret base. Sabo is captured and presented to his noble father.

episodes.name: Episode 482
episodes.description: Ace lowers his head to show his gratitude to Whitebeard. Gazing upon the tattoo on Ace's back, Whitebeard asks him one simple question.

episodes.name: Episode 494
episodes.description: Ace meets up with his friend Sabo in the forest after mugging a couple of men. Luffy gets captured when a pirate comes looking for Ace.

episodes.name: Episode 468
episodes.description: Ace's heart aches as he sees his friends and Luffy fighting for him. Ace tells Garp that he is ready to accept whatever fate awaits him.

episodes.name: Episode 466
episodes.description: After falling from the sky into the thick of battle, Luffy frantically searches for Ace. Luffy spots Ace on the scaffold and yells out his name.

episodes.name: Episode 476
episodes.description: Aokiji intercepts Whitebeard. Luffy gets attacked by Momonga. Whitebeard catches Luffy after Kizaru sends him flying with another kick.

episodes.name: Episode 459
episodes.description: As Ace climbs up the seemingly endless stairs to the execution grounds in Marineford, he remembers talking to Luffy about freedom.

episodes.name: Episode 480
episodes.description: As Luffy runs up to the scaffold, he is intercepted by none other than his grandfather Garp. As they collide, they reflect on their shared pasts.

episodes.name: Episode 487
episodes.description: Blackbeard threatens to sink Marineford into the sea with his newly acquired powers. Sengoku uses his abilities to stop Blackbeard at any cost.

episodes.name: Episode 515
episodes.description: Brook puts on a performance in front of an audience after receiving Luffy's message. Robin heads toward Baltigo with the Revolutionary Army.

episodes.name: Episode 510
episodes.description: Chopper reads a shocking newspaper article about Luffy while catching a ride on the back of a giant bird. Sanji gets beaten by Ivankov.

episodes.name: Episode 462
episodes.description: Claiming to have ordered Ace to go after Blackbeard himself, Whitebeard and his crew threaten the navy for hurting one of their own.

episodes.name: Episode 502
episodes.description: Dadan arrives to save Ace from Bluejam. When Ace refuses to run away, Dadan orders her men to take Luffy and get to safety.

episodes.name: Episode 505
episodes.description: Dadan flies into a rage and blames Garp for not protecting Ace. When Makino defends Garp, Dadan tells her that Luffy is suffering the hardest.

episodes.name: Episode 513
episodes.description: Drake and Apoo make their way into the New World as Law waits for the right moment to make his move. Bonney has been captured by Blackbeard.

episodes.name: Episode 474
episodes.description: Even Whitebeard's powers prove ineffective against the massive walls. Akainu hurls molten lava from the sky toward Whitebeard's ship.

episodes.name: Episode 460
episodes.description: Executing Ace will carry a symbolic meaning. Garp remembers the day Roger asked him from his prison cell to take care of his unborn child.

episodes.name: Episode 479
episodes.description: Garp and the others are astonished that Luffy has the ability to use Conqueror's Haki. Whitebeard roars for everyone to focus on helping Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 493
episodes.description: Garp brings little Luffy to go live with the Dadans, a family of mountain bandits. Luffy meets Ace, who had been sent there by Garp earlier.

episodes.name: Episode 516
episodes.description: Jimbei and Luffy part ways after promising to meet up on Fishman Island in two years. Hancock leaves Luffy and Rayleigh on a deserted island.

episodes.name: Episode 475
episodes.description: Kizaru kicks Luffy away as he tries to reach Ace. Sengoku finally gives the order for the executioners to perform their duty.

episodes.name: Episode 464
episodes.description: Little Oars Jr. helps the Whitebeard Pirates by picking up and hurling a navy warship. Coby feels helplessly outranked in power by those around him.

episodes.name: Episode 484
episodes.description: Luffy along with the Whitebeard Pirates and their associates cry inconsolably. Akainu seizes the moment to close in on the despondent Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 472
episodes.description: Luffy and the others are frozen in shock as one of Whitebeard's supposed allies declares for all to hear that Whitebeard had cut a deal with the Navy.

episodes.name: Episode 473
episodes.description: Luffy and the others charge forward after Whitebeard starts to make his way toward Ace. The navy pulls back and prepares to raise defensive walls.

episodes.name: Episode 470
episodes.description: Luffy avoids getting involved in a battle with Mihawk, but he cannot run from his powers. To protect Luffy, Jimbei challenges Mihawk to a fight.

episodes.name: Episode 481
episodes.description: Luffy has freed Ace at last. Together, the brothers coordinate their attacks to unleash their combined Devil Fruit powers upon the navy.

episodes.name: Episode 469
episodes.description: Luffy hugs Hancock tight to express his gratitude for giving him the key to Ace's handcuffs. Hancock daydreams about getting married to Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 467
episodes.description: Luffy informs Whitebeard on what he heard about the change of plans. The Whitebeard Pirates, Jimbei, Ivankov and the others follow Luffy's lead.

episodes.name: Episode 478
episodes.description: Luffy starts running toward Ace again. Coby, who has long admired Luffy, stands resolute to face his old friend as a member of the navy.

episodes.name: Episode 498
episodes.description: Luffy, Ace and Sabo all want to be the one in charge of their own ship. The boys decide to compete to see who will become the captain of the trio.

episodes.name: Episode 506
episodes.description: Mihawk approaches Zoro in the ruins of the Muggy Kingdom. The other Straw Hats' thoughts turn to Luffy when they learn about what happened to Ace.

episodes.name: Episode 463
episodes.description: Mihawk swings his sword toward Whitebeard, but Jozu intercepts his attack. Marco shields Whitebeard against an onslaught from Kizaru.

episodes.name: Episode 465
episodes.description: Moria prevents Oars Jr. from reaching Ace. Coby witnesses Akainu dealing with a deserter while running away from all the action.

episodes.name: Episode 508
episodes.description: Nami attempts to leave Weatheria to get to the Sabaody Archipelago. Franky breaks into a lab in search of a way out of Baldimore.

episodes.name: Episode 514
episodes.description: Nami decides to stay in Weatheria after realizing the meaning of Luffy's message. Franky moves into Dr. Vegapunk's other lab.

episodes.name: Episode 471
episodes.description: No one is able to hide their astonishment as the navy deploys an army of Pacifistas. The navy and the Pacifistas clash with Whitebeard's allies.

episodes.name: Episode 491
episodes.description: Pirates move in to forcefully take over the former Whitebeard territories. Luffy is brought to Amazon Lily to keep him safe from his enemies.

episodes.name: Episode 507
episodes.description: Rayleigh arrives on the Island of Women and explains that Kuma's confession and Shakky's intuition led him in the right direction toward Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 503
episodes.description: Sabo has set sail under a pirate flag. The Celestial Dragon fires upon the vessel, incensed that a mere commoner would dare cross his path.

episodes.name: Episode 495
episodes.description: Sabo tries to take Luffy and run away, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight. Hearing this, Sabo decides to stay and support Ace.

episodes.name: Episode 501
episodes.description: Sabo tries to warn Ace and Luffy that the king and the nobles are planning to burn down Gray Terminal. That night, the junkyard is set alight.

episodes.name: Episode 489
episodes.description: Ten years ago, Shanks let Luffy borrow his straw hat. Shanks contemplates seeing him, but memories of the past remind him about their promise.

episodes.name: Episode 485
episodes.description: The Blackbeard Pirates have appeared seemingly out of nowhere. Whitebeard decides to teach Blackbeard a lesson for committing betrayal and murder.

episodes.name: Episode 497
episodes.description: The Dadan Family has their hands full with the rowdy trio. After being disciplined by Garp, the boys declare independence and run away together.

episodes.name: Episode 483
episodes.description: The combined efforts of the Whitebeard Pirates have no effect against Akainu's powers. Whitebeard gets attacked by Kizaru while trying to stop Akainu.

episodes.name: Episode 511
episodes.description: The navy discusses the recent incident that involves the sudden reappearance of Luffy, Rayleigh and Jimbei at Marineford.

episodes.name: Episode 512
episodes.description: The news of Luffy's activities at Marineford spreads far and wide. In Sabaody Archipelago, Duval continues to look after the Sunny.

episodes.name: Episode 486
episodes.description: The news of the great man's demise spreads far and wide. While Buggy starts to flee, Blackbeard gets under a piece of cloth with Whitebeard.

episodes.name: Episode 488
episodes.description: The remaining Whitebeard Pirates fight to save Luffy from the relentless Akainu. Coby reaches his breaking point over the senselessness of battle.

episodes.name: Episode 490
episodes.description: The war is over and the people rejoice. The pirates enter an era without Whitebeard. Sengoku learns about Blackbeard's new recruits from Impel Down.

episodes.name: Episode 499
episodes.description: Try as they might, Ace and Sabo are still no match for the giant tiger. Luffy starts to get the hang of his powers while training under Naguri.

episodes.name: Episode 477
episodes.description: Whitebeard and Akainu clash as the pirates and the navy continue fighting. Ace cries tears of happiness over the outpouring of support for himself.

episodes.name: Episode 461
episodes.description: Whitebeard emerges from his ship. Ace remembers when he started his own pirate crew, encountered Jimbei and met Whitebeard.

episodes.name: Episode 509
episodes.description: Zoro desperately tries to get to the Sabaody Archipelago after speaking with Mihawk. Brook deals with the conflict in Hungeria.

episodes.name: Episode 504
episodes.description: Zoro trains at the dojo while Dragon returns to his ship nearby. Ace and Luffy grow stronger and bigger without Sabo at their side.

episodes.name: Episode 457
episodes.description: Ace's execution is just moments away as Luffy and the others make their way toward his location. Luffy reminisces about Ace with Jimbei.

episodes.name: Episode 438
episodes.description: After apologizing to Luffy about having run away without him, Bon Clay takes his dying friend around Impel Down in search of the miraculous Ivan-san.

episodes.name: Episode 443
episodes.description: An adversary from the past offers to fight alongside Luffy and the others. Luffy decides to trust Jimbei when he expresses his desire to help Ace.

episodes.name: Episode 439
episodes.description: Bon Clay begs Ivan-san to help Luffy after witnessing his miraculous powers at the secret New Kama Land within the prison.

episodes.name: Episode 440
episodes.description: Bon Clay learns Ivan-san's secrets: New Kama Land is a space between Levels 5 and 6 that was created by a prisoner with digging powers.

episodes.name: Episode 424
episodes.description: Buggy is amazed to see how strong Luffy has become. He is even more surprised to see Luffy has an armband that holds an important clue.

episodes.name: Episode 428
episodes.description: Even Zoro and Sanji are captured by Largo's Net-Net powers. Thinking of the good of the villagers, Boss gives himself up to the Amigo Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 422
episodes.description: Garp tells the imprisoned Ace about the big incident Luffy caused at the Sabaody Archipelago. A lone pirate ship heads toward Impel Down.

episodes.name: Episode 441
episodes.description: Having made a miraculous recovery, Luffy tells Bon Clay that he is indebted to him. Ivan-san wants to help Luffy after learning who his father is.

episodes.name: Episode 448
episodes.description: Ivan-san stands firm by himself and unleashes his techniques on Magellan to prevent him from reaching Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 445
episodes.description: Luffy and the others free prisoners as they continue to fight. Buggy and Mr. 3 are trapped by Magellan's venom. Shiryu faces the Blackbeard Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 446
episodes.description: Luffy and the others try to push through to Level 3, but Hannyabal and his men stand in the way. Hannyabal attacks Luffy with his naginata.

episodes.name: Episode 435
episodes.description: Luffy finally goes face to face with Magellan, but Bon Clay insists on running away instead of trying to fight someone with such powers.

episodes.name: Episode 437
episodes.description: Luffy gets imprisoned on Level 5 after being gravely injured beyond hope. Bon Clay heads to look for a person who can help heal Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 442
episodes.description: Luffy gets to Level 6 with Ivan-san's help. He desperately calls out to Ace, but there is no answer; Ace has already been taken from his cell.

episodes.name: Episode 425
episodes.description: Luffy is desperate to get to Ace, but fearsome creatures attack him and Buggy. Hancock gets to Level 4 and meets Magellan, the warden of Impel Down.

episodes.name: Episode 447
episodes.description: Luffy is overpowered by Teach, aka Blackbeard, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Teach boastfully reveals what his powers are capable of.

episodes.name: Episode 426
episodes.description: Luffy takes a liking to a giant beetle and tries to get it to join his crew, but the beetle is already a loyal companion of a little girl named Yoko.

episodes.name: Episode 433
episodes.description: Luffy works together with Bon Clay to defeat their foes. Hancock leaves Impel Down after having witnessed Magellan's powers with her own eyes.

episodes.name: Episode 436
episodes.description: Luffy's fist gets covered in venom after he puts all his might into a single blow against Magellan. Bon Clay feels utterly guilty for running away.

episodes.name: Episode 451
episodes.description: Magellan orders one of the warships to come to him in order to go after the escaped convicts. The Gate of Justice looms before Luffy and the others.

episodes.name: Episode 449
episodes.description: Mr. 3 creates a protective wall when Magellan attacks Luffy and the others with his Hydra. Luffy decides to team up with Mr. 3 to fight Magellan.

episodes.name: Episode 453
episodes.description: Nami grows impatient at the sluggish pace of progress as she heads to the Sabaody Archipelago after landing on the Sky Island of Weatheria.

episodes.name: Episode 444
episodes.description: On Level 2, Buggy and Mr. 3 celebrate when they realize they have a chance to escape Impel Down. Ivan-san and Bon Clay catch up with Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 430
episodes.description: One of the Seven Warlords of the Sea gets beat up by a prison guard on Level 5. Having witnessed the abuse, Ace speaks up and talks to him.

episodes.name: Episode 456
episodes.description: Perona has treated Zoro's injuries in the ruins of Muggy Kingdom. She tries to order him around, but Zoro is having none of it.

episodes.name: Episode 429
episodes.description: Realizing the importance of both Boss and their island, the villagers rise up with help from Nami and the others. Luffy takes Largo on by himself.

episodes.name: Episode 423
episodes.description: Regretfully, Hancock tells Luffy that she has done as much as she can to help him. Luffy thanks Hancock and promises not to stir up trouble.

episodes.name: Episode 455
episodes.description: Robin has been caught and imprisoned. A guard at Tequila Wolf interrogates her about the whereabouts of the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 454
episodes.description: Sanji runs from the inhabitants of Peachy Island. Chopper works hard to survive among the giant birds that rule Birdie Kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 452
episodes.description: Shiryu treats the Blackbeard Pirates with antivenom in the nick of time. Buggy and the others start to panic when they realize where they are headed.

episodes.name: Episode 450
episodes.description: The Marines are dumbfounded as Jimbei destroys their warship after Crocodile and Mr. 1 land on it. Luffy and Magellan's fight continues.

episodes.name: Episode 458
episodes.description: The Warlords of the Sea aside from Jimbei and Blackbeard have gathered at the navy headquarters. The three admirals including Akainu also arrive.

episodes.name: Episode 432
episodes.description: The navy dispatches their men to Impel Down in order to capture Luffy while they can still save face. Hancock meets Ace on Level 5 at last.

episodes.name: Episode 431
episodes.description: The prison guards start to panic as they realize that Luffy's objective is to save Ace. Garp laughs off the situation back at the navy headquarters.

episodes.name: Episode 434
episodes.description: Through an unforeseen accident, Luffy and the others all fall down to Level 4. Hancock asks Momonga when Ace's execution will take place.

episodes.name: Episode 427
episodes.description: Yoko lives on an island where the buildings are based off famous spots in East Blue. Zoro, Usopp and Sanji are reminded of their loved ones from home.

episodes.name: Episode 147
episodes.description: After being laughed at about Sky Island, Luffy and Zoro don't fight back as Bellamy beats them. Nami carries her wounded friends out of the bar.

episodes.name: Episode 151
episodes.description: Bellamy laughs at Luffy for coming to take back the gold. At the World Government's capital, the Five Elders discuss who should succeed Crocodile.

episodes.name: Episode 163
episodes.description: Ganfor gets caught in a trap during a lightning-fast aerial battle against Shura. Luffy fights back against Satori by making an unexpected move.

episodes.name: Episode 172
episodes.description: Gedatsu attacks Chopper at the ruins with his swamp clouds. Chopper takes a direct hit from Gedatsu even after taking a Rumble Ball to get away.

episodes.name: Episode 145
episodes.description: Huge shadows loom over Luffy and the others after they escape from a giant sea turtle. Ace shows up on Buggy's ship in the middle of a feast.

episodes.name: Episode 154
episodes.description: Luffy and his crew arrive in Skypiea and enjoy their freedom away from the Marines. Sanji is ecstatic to meet Conis, an angelic citizen of the island.

episodes.name: Episode 167
episodes.description: Luffy and the others free the Going Merry from the sacrificial altar. The priests prepare for Wyper and his warriors to start attacking them again.

episodes.name: Episode 168
episodes.description: Luffy and the others get separated while running away from a ludicrously big python. On the Going Merry, Ganfor talks about the history of Sky Island.

episodes.name: Episode 159
episodes.description: Luffy and the others set off for Upper Yard. After somehow getting past a number of deadly traps, the trio comes across entrances marked with ordeals.

episodes.name: Episode 161
episodes.description: Luffy and the others struggle to fight against their unpredictable opponent. Chopper looks after the Going Merry by himself at the sacrificial altar.

episodes.name: Episode 148
episodes.description: Luffy and the others visit a man named Cricket to learn more about Sky Island. Cricket, as it turns out, is a descendant of the infamous liar Noland.

episodes.name: Episode 144
episodes.description: Luffy finds a "Sky Island" map from a galleon that fell from the sky. To gather more information, Luffy, Zoro and Sanji head to the bottom of the sea.

episodes.name: Episode 158
episodes.description: Luffy, Usopp and Sanji head to a dock with Conis in order to save Nami and the others. There, Conis confesses that she called for the shrimp to come.

episodes.name: Episode 173
episodes.description: Nami fights to protect her friends and the Going Merry from Hotori and Kotori, who have come to avenge their brother Satori.

episodes.name: Episode 156
episodes.description: Nami loses her temper when she learns that she and her friends must pay an exorbitant sum of 7 million berries for entering Skypiea illegally.

episodes.name: Episode 146
episodes.description: Nami makes Luffy and Zoro promise that they won't get into fights after arriving in Mock Town, but they soon have an encounter with Bellamy the Hyena.

episodes.name: Episode 166
episodes.description: Nami reveals she has figured out the possible location of the city of gold by putting together a layout of Jaya as it looked 400 years ago.

episodes.name: Episode 160
episodes.description: Of the four choices before him, Luffy chooses to go through the "Ordeal of Balls." A priest named Satori appears as the trio lets their guard down.

episodes.name: Episode 162
episodes.description: Shura the priest sets the Going Merry aflame. Chopper finds himself in trouble while desperately trying to stop the fire from consuming the ship.

episodes.name: Episode 153
episodes.description: The Going Merry enters a sea in the sky. A masked assailant suddenly appears, but Luffy, Sanji and Zoro are unable to fight properly due to thin air.

episodes.name: Episode 164
episodes.description: The Shandians commence attacking Upper Yard under Wyper's command. Nami and the others stumble across the truth of what Upper Yard really is.

episodes.name: Episode 169
episodes.description: The Shandians get tangled up in the Ordeal of String. Shura strikes at Wyper's shoulder with his weapon, but Wyper has a hidden trick up his sleeve.

episodes.name: Episode 157
episodes.description: The Straw Hats are now wanted criminals. A giant shrimp carries off with the Going Merry with Nami and the others still on board.

episodes.name: Episode 152
episodes.description: The Straw Hats go out to sea and head south with the Saruyama Alliance. Below the cloud they were looking for, they find a giant whirlpool.

episodes.name: Episode 149
episodes.description: The Straw Hats search for a South Bird to guide them in the right direction after learning that the Sky Island may be inside a peculiar type of cloud.

episodes.name: Episode 155
episodes.description: The sacred Upper Yard is strictly off-limits. Luffy is eager to set foot inside such a forbidden place while others worry about Nami's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Episode 150
episodes.description: While giant bugs attack Luffy and his crew in the dark forest, Bellamy uses his Devil Fruit powers to take the gold artifacts from Cricket.

episodes.name: Episode 165
episodes.description: While the battle between the Shandians and the priests rages on, Luffy and the others finally meet back up with the rest of their crew.

episodes.name: Episode 171
episodes.description: Wyper decides to use the Burn Bazooka and commences firing. Luffy counters the warrior's attack head on with his own bazooka attack.

episodes.name: Episode 170
episodes.description: Zoro gets targeted by a Shandian warrior that skates across the sky. The flashing attacks from his opponent make it hard for Zoro to counterattack.

episodes.name: The Power of Satiety! A New Fourth-Gear Form, Tank-Man!
episodes.description: After eating his way through countless biscuit warriors, Luffy’s stomach reaches its limit. Cracker finally moves in to attack Luffy directly.

episodes.name: A Storm of Revenge! An Enraged Army Comes to Attack!
episodes.description: Big Mom is furious after learning of Cracker’s defeat. Storm clouds fill the skies above Whole Cake Island as her enormous army descends on Luffy.

episodes.name: An All-Out Duel! Fourth Gear vs. the Bis-Bis Ability
episodes.description: Cracker’s defense remains impenetrable, forcing Luffy to use increasingly powerful attacks. Brook and Pedro continue their infiltration of Sweet City.

episodes.name: A Top Officer! The Sweet 3 General Cracker Appears!
episodes.description: Following Big Mom’s orders, Cracker confronts Luffy and Nami in the forest. Nami realizes the rugged giant has a connection to an old friend of hers.

episodes.name: The Benefactor's Life! Sanji and Owner Zeff!
episodes.description: Judge uses a photo of Sanji’s benefactor Zeff to threaten his son into good behavior. Luffy finally reaches his limit in the fight against Cracker.

episodes.name: The First and the Second Join! The Vinsmoke Family!
episodes.description: Luffy can’t break through Cracker’s infinite biscuit soldiers. Chopper has a plan to take advantage of the mirror world he and Carrot are trapped in.

episodes.name: An Enemy Worth 800 million! Luffy vs. Thousand Armed Cracker!
episodes.description: Luffy can’t even land a hit on Cracker, who can multiply his limbs by simply tapping his body. Nami tries to escape, but she is obstructed by Brûlée.

episodes.name: A Battle of Limits! Luffy and the Infinite Biscuits!
episodes.description: Nami discovers a weakness of Cracker’s biscuit warriors that turns the tide of the battle. Luffy takes advantage by using an unexpected method.

episodes.name: An Angry Sanji! The Secret of Germa 66!
episodes.description: Nami orders the king of the forest to shelter Luffy until he regains his energy. Sanji is enraged when he finds the chef Cosette knocked out cold.

episodes.name: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! Part One
episodes.description: Sanji remembers the time when he first met Luffy aboard Zeff’s ship. Luffy and Nami receive a message from Chopper and race to Big Mom’s castle.

episodes.name: To the East Blue! Sanji's Resolute Departure!
episodes.description: Six months after being imprisoned in the dungeons by Judge, Sanji remembers cooking for his mother. He tells Reiju about his desire to become a chef.

episodes.name: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! Part Two
episodes.description: Tied down by his father’s threats, a cold Sanji tries to drive Luffy away. When Luffy doesn’t back down, Sanji is forced to get physical with him.

episodes.name: The Past that He Let Go of! Vinsmoke Sanji!
episodes.description: With Luffy still not recovered, Nami engages Cracker. Meanwhile, Sanji is reminded that he cannot oppose his family as long as Zeff is held hostage.

episodes.name: Episode 1118
episodes.description: After encountering Bonney, Sabo learns of a secret room in Pangaea Castle. Meanwhile, King Cobra asks the Five Elders about his ancestor.

episodes.name: Episode 1119
episodes.description: After hearing Imu's words, King Cobra realizes he may not leave the throne room alive. Just as Imu angrily attacks, Sabo leaps into action.

episodes.name: Episode 1111
episodes.description: After learning that Kizaru is approaching Egghead with a massive fleet, Sentomaru urges the researchers to flee. The traitor confronts Vegapunk.

episodes.name: Episode 1092
episodes.description: After parting with the giant Dr. Vegapunk, Luffy and his companions get some fancy new clothes. They soon encounter a familiar-looking police officer.

episodes.name: Episode 1108
episodes.description: After the Seraphim begin attacking, Shaka suspects that one of the Vegapunk Satellites is a traitor. Lucci and Kaku offer to help repel the assault.

episodes.name: Episode 1102
episodes.description: As CP-0 regains control of the powerful Seraphim, the Straw Hats plan to get Vegapunk aboard the Thousand Sunny and escape from Egghead.

episodes.name: Episode 1099
episodes.description: As Lucci's group launches its invasion of Egghead, Shaka deploys three Seraphim to defend the island. Atlas tries taking things into her own hands.

episodes.name: Episode 1100
episodes.description: As Luffy and Lucci power up and go toe-to-toe in an intense brawl, Vegapunk reveals his jaw-dropping theory about the nature of the Devil Fruits.

episodes.name: Episode 1112
episodes.description: As Shanks and his crew prepare to battle the Kid Pirates, he has a premonition of his fleet being destroyed and hurries to strike first.

episodes.name: Episode 1109
episodes.description: As the Seraphim continue their rampage, Luffy and Zoro fight back while protecting the captive Lucci and Kaku. Luffy makes a surprising decision.

episodes.name: Episode 1122
episodes.description: As the island monster threatens to crush the marine ship, the wounded Garp gives Koby, Helmeppo and Prince Grus a seemingly impossible set of orders.

episodes.name: Episode 1107
episodes.description: Bonney resolves to keep exploring Kuma's painful memories. While the Straw Hats continue searching for Vegapunk, an intruder stalks the lab.

episodes.name: Episode 1121
episodes.description: Garp attempts to escape from Beehive with his comrades, but Kuzan stands in their way. The two men clash in a battle of mentor versus former pupil.

episodes.name: Episode 1106
episodes.description: Having taken control of the Fabriophase, CP-0 agents attempt to trap Vegapunk but face a powerful adversary. The Straw Hats search for Vegapunk.

episodes.name: Episode 1120
episodes.description: Igaram and his fellow guards desperately search for King Cobra and Vivi. Sabo and the others stow away on different ships and escape from Mary Geoise.

episodes.name: Episode 1090
episodes.description: Jimbei maneuvers the Thousand Sunny away from the jaws of a massive mechanical shark, but Luffy, Chopper and the mysterious girl fall into the sea.

episodes.name: Episode 1115
episodes.description: Kuzan recalls an evening of revelry, drinking and swapping stories with the Blackbeard Pirates, and how he was invited to join their crew.

episodes.name: Episode 1093
episodes.description: Law and the Heart Pirates dock at a nearby island in an attempt to evade Blackbeard and his buccaneers, who aim to take Law's Ponegliff copies.

episodes.name: Episode 1101
episodes.description: Luffy tries to prevent Lucci from dealing a finishing blow to Sentomaru. Vegapunk explains how he was able to give the Seraphim their powers.

episodes.name: Episode 1095
episodes.description: Nami and her group fight the winged being resembling Jimbei — unaware that some of the Vegapunks are observing and analyzing the battle from afar.

episodes.name: Episode 1116
episodes.description: News of Vice Admiral T-Bone's death in the line of duty shocks the public. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a rousing speech to the Cross Guild crew.

episodes.name: Episode 1113
episodes.description: On the Pirate Island of Beehive, Perona frees Koby from prison. The local pirates quickly learn of the escape and set out to claim the bounty on him.

episodes.name: Episode 1117
episodes.description: Sabo begins recounting the Revolutionary Army's sudden attack on Mary Geoise during the Reverie and how it freed the people enslaved there.

episodes.name: Episode 1096
episodes.description: Shaka describes his theory about an ancient kingdom that has been erased from history — a theory that connects to the destruction of Robin's homeland.

episodes.name: Episode 1097
episodes.description: Shaka explains how Ohara’s destruction led to the Revolutionary Army’s foundation. He then tells Robin and her group he has something to show them.

episodes.name: Episode 1105
episodes.description: Shaka reveals that Stussy has been Vegapunk's spy for over 20 years. Zoro and the others attempt to stop the Seraphim’s powerful assault.

episodes.name: Episode 1094
episodes.description: Thanks to Bonney’s ability, Luffy's group evades the Pacifista. Meanwhile, Lilith brings the other Straw Hats to a lab on the clouds above Egghead.

episodes.name: Episode 1110
episodes.description: The Seraphim's resilience reminds Zoro of a powerful past foe. Nami's group faces S-Shark, while Franky's group struggles against S-Snake.

episodes.name: Episode 1089
episodes.description: The Straw Hats must find the final Road Ponegliff to reach Laugh Tale, but they have no clue where it could be. Sabo contacts the Revolutionary Army.

episodes.name: Episode 1114
episodes.description: The pirates open fire on Koby, but Hibari comes to his rescue with a flowery counterattack. Garp launches a devastating assault on the island.

episodes.name: Episode 1091
episodes.description: The woman claiming to be Dr. Vegapunk demands that the Straw Hats hand over their valuables. Meanwhile, Luffy's group explores the island of Egghead.

episodes.name: Episode 1098
episodes.description: Vegapunk asks Luffy to take him away from Egghead. Meanwhile, a World Government ship carrying members of Cipher Pol approaches the island.

episodes.name: Episode 1104
episodes.description: Vegapunk begs Bonney to keep away from the paw-print-shaped concentration of energy. Meanwhile, the Seraphim follow CP-0 to the Labophase.

episodes.name: Episode 1103
episodes.description: Zoro defends the Thousand Sunny against Kaku's attack. An angry Bonney chases Vegapunk, determined to learn the truth about her father, Kuma.

seasons.name: Enter Chopper at the Winter Island

episodes.name: Episode 89
episodes.description: After getting kicked by Luffy, Wapol declares that he will transform himself into a human weapon. Dalton and the others head to the castle.

episodes.name: Episode 83
episodes.description: Chess and Kuromarimo are intercepted by giant rabbits. Luffy climbs the Drum Rockies with Nami and Sanji. Vivi and the others arrive back in Bighorn.

episodes.name: Episode 86
episodes.description: Chopper finds mushrooms to treat the ailing Hiriluk. With his research finally complete, Hiriluk asks Kureha to teach Chopper medicine.

episodes.name: Episode 88
episodes.description: Chopper gains a deeper understanding of what it means to be a pirate as he watches Luffy defend Hiriluk's flag. Doctors volunteer to save Dalton.

episodes.name: Episode 91
episodes.description: Chopper realizes how much Kureha loves him as the Straw Hats celebrate their newest member aboard the Going Merry. Dalton hears about a man named Ace.

episodes.name: Episode 92
episodes.description: Crocodile starts a sandstorm and instantly mummifies the pirates that were looting a harbor town. The Straw Hats fish Bon Clay out of the sea.

episodes.name: Episode 87
episodes.description: Kureha tells Wapol that she turned the castle into a memorial for Hiriluk. Wapol finds an opportunity to start chomping down on Chopper.

episodes.name: Episode 81
episodes.description: Kureha treats a boy in the next town over as Luffy and the others encounter giant rabbits. Dalton reveals Wapol's past misdeeds.

episodes.name: Episode 85
episodes.description: Luffy asks Chopper to join the crew. Kureha talks to Nami and Sanji about Hiriluk, a doctor who continued to treat patients during the doctor hunt.

episodes.name: Episode 90
episodes.description: Nami is allowed to leave the castle after making a deal with Kureha. Chopper decides to join the Straw Hats, but Kureha refuses to let him go.

episodes.name: Episode 84
episodes.description: Nami meets Chopper after receiving treatment. Luffy and Sanji try to eat Chopper. Villagers find Dalton buried in the snow.

episodes.name: Episode 78
episodes.description: The Going Merry and the Straw Hats blast out of a giant goldfish with help from their friends. Bon Clay receives an order. Nami falls gravely ill.

episodes.name: Episode 82
episodes.description: The herd of giant rabbits starts an avalanche. Dalton is injured when he stands up against Wapol. Luffy helps a young giant rabbit.

episodes.name: Episode 80
episodes.description: Vivi continues to ask for a doctor after the villagers turn their guns toward the crew. A man named Dalton leads Luffy and the others into town.

episodes.name: Episode 79
episodes.description: Wapol and his crew attack the Going Merry as snow falls all around them. Smoker intercepts the conversation between Sanji and Mr. 0.

episodes.name: Z’s Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!
episodes.description: After the Straw Hat Pirates face perilously peculiar conditions in a dangerous part of the New World sea, they notice that their food is disappearing.

episodes.name: Fists Collide! A Battle of the Two Vice Admirals!
episodes.description: An intense fight ensues as a furious Smoker seeks revenge for Vergo's betrayal. Meanwhile, Caesar Clown sets the wheels of his plan in motion.

episodes.name: A Mastermind Underground! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
episodes.description: Caesar is granted a moment of respite when Monet steps in to hold off Luffy. Law makes it to the SAD room, but unwelcome company is on the way.

episodes.name: Shaking Up the New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!
episodes.description: Caesar takes the children back to the lab before locking them up. Later, he shows Luffy's group his evil plan for Smiley as it unfolds on a monitor.

episodes.name: A Surprising Outcome! White Chase vs. Vergo!
episodes.description: Caesar’s gas abilities have little effect on an enraged Luffy. Meanwhile, Smoker is pushed to his limits as he continues to battle Vergo.

episodes.name: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks Into the Ice-Cold Lake!
episodes.description: Centaur leader Brownbeard capsizes the boat Luffy's gang are in. Meanwhile, Law switches up the other Straw Hats in a move that pleases Sanji greatly.

episodes.name: A Major Turnaround! Luffy's Angry Iron Fist Strikes!
episodes.description: Chopper and the dugong are surrounded as Breed orders his pets to attack. Just when it seems all hope is lost, some unexpected reinforcements arrive.

episodes.name: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Shinokuni!
episodes.description: Consuming the trap, Smiley transforms into a deadly gas that swallows all in its path. Zoro, Sanji, Brook and Kinemon run for their lives.

episodes.name: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!
episodes.description: Determined to uncover who's behind the child kidnappings and get back his own body, Smoker's intuition tells him there may be foul play in his ranks.

episodes.name: Luffy Dies at Sea?! The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!
episodes.description: Falling for Breed's trap, Luffy and Law are forced into a fight to the death. A distressed dugong begs Breed to have mercy, but to no avail.

episodes.name: Running Wild! Invincible General Franky!
episodes.description: Franky is locked in a battle with Baby 5 and Buffalo. Meanwhile, Luffy refuses to flee the complex until Chopper and the others arrive.

episodes.name: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!
episodes.description: Hot on the tracks of Nami, Luffy comes face-to-face with the Yeti Cool Brothers. Elsewhere, Smoker and Tashigi join their fellow marines in battle.

episodes.name: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!
episodes.description: Immune to Caesar Clown's gas attacks, Luffy and the Straw Hats seem to succeed in overcoming him, but Caesar may still have something up his sleeve.

episodes.name: A Deadly Fight in a Blizzard! The Straw Hats vs. the Snow Woman!
episodes.description: In a bid to protect the others, Zoro engages in an intense dual with Monet. Elsewhere, Luffy’s climb proves to be trickier than he thought.

episodes.name: Raid! An Assassin from Dressrosa!
episodes.description: In a hectic dash for survival, the Straw Hats and the others hurry to leave the collapsing complex. Fortunately, Usopp is on hand to offer directions.

episodes.name: Z’s Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!
episodes.description: In the thick of a hectic three-way battle, Nami spots an opportunity to escape by harnessing the power of a dangerous incoming Thrust Up Stream.

episodes.name: Intense! Aokiji vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Interrupted by former marine admiral Kuzan, Doflamingo takes his leave with Buffalo and Baby 5 in tow. Kuzan gives Smoker a word of warning.

episodes.name: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'emon!
episodes.description: Law is stopped in his tracks by a mysterious figure. Elsewhere, the samurai reveals his identity when, thanks to Sanji, he’s reunited with his torso.

episodes.name: Launching the Counter Attack! Luffy and Law’s Great Escape!
episodes.description: Law reveals his escape plans, but he needs Franky's help. Meanwhile, the gas is closing in fast on Brownbeard, Zoro and the other Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.name: Caesar's Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!
episodes.description: Law’s attack proves catastrophic for the entire lab. Luffy summons all he's got in a last-ditch attempt to defeat an empowered, gas-consuming Caesar.

episodes.name: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. the Giant Dragon!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro encounter a hostile dragon on Punk Hazard. Meanwhile, mysterious beings donned in hazmat suits sneak aboard the Thousand Sunny.

episodes.name: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes a Sortie!
episodes.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats enjoy a peaceful voyage to Dressrosa, until an unknown enemy named Breed takes Caesar. Luffy and Law go in pursuit.

episodes.name: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai’s Horrifying Severed Head!
episodes.description: Luffy rescues a living pair of legs from the dragon's nose as the group ventures deeper inland. Elsewhere, Nami and the others awake in a lab complex.

episodes.name: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!
episodes.description: Luffy sets out with some of his crew to find Master, but while they're away the Yeti Cool Brothers pay those left in the lab an unwelcome visit.

episodes.name: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!
episodes.description: Luffy strikes first when he finally tracks down Caesar Clown, but the Straw Hat is in for a grueling battle as Caesar makes full use of his powers.

episodes.name: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start To Fight!
episodes.description: Luffy's gang spot hostile centaurs as they head for the cold side of Punk Hazard. Back at the complex, the giant children beg to escape with Nami.

episodes.name: A Small Dragon! Momonosuke Appears!
episodes.description: Luffy’s new acquaintance explains how a moment of hunger cost him his humanity. In a sudden fit of panic, the two begin their ascent of the chasm.

episodes.name: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!
episodes.description: Luffy’s party gatecrashes a battle as they look for Caesar. Meanwhile, the giant children awake from their slumber, giving Usopp and Nami a hard time.

episodes.name: To Save Her Friends! Mocha Runs at the Risk of Her Life!
episodes.description: Mocha tries sticking to the plan she made with Chopper, but as the children catch up to her, she determines to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!
episodes.description: Monet freely manipulates Luffy with her ice powers, causing him to plummet down a deep pit. Chopper struggles to calm the candy-craving children.

episodes.name: Save the Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close In!
episodes.description: Nami and Usopp receive a visit from Caesar, who tries to turn the giant children against them. Fortunately, an unexpected reinforcement steps up.

episodes.name: The Warlord! Trafalgar Law!
episodes.description: Nami and the giant children finally find a way out of the complex, only to run into Smoker squaring up to a familiar, yet fearsome adversary.

episodes.name: Z’s Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!
episodes.description: Nami forms a cunning plan to rescue Lily's father from a formidable Marine force, with the Straw Hats splitting into groups to beguile the captors.

episodes.name: Brownbeard in Grief! Luffy Lands a Furious Blow!
episodes.description: Panic ensues as the deadly gas gradually fills the complex. Amid the chaos, Usopp comes across the main door to Caesar’s surveillance room.

episodes.name: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!
episodes.description: Regaining consciousness, Zoro’s group catch up to the samurai but Caesar’s slimy weapon is soon on their heels. Back at the lab, Luffy has a plan.

episodes.name: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
episodes.description: Reunited with his legs, the samurai goes in search of his torso. Meanwhile, Chopper figures out the cause of the children’s sudden sickness.

episodes.name: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin'emon!
episodes.description: Sanji prepares a celebratory feast for both the Straw Hats and the marines, while Brook’s clumsiness sets in motion a heartwarming reunion.

episodes.name: Startling! The Secret of the Island Is Finally Revealed!
episodes.description: Sanji takes a living samurai's head with him as the group makes for an escape from the complex -- only to run into a room full of giant children.

episodes.name: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo's Sudden Attack!
episodes.description: Seething with rage, Doflamingo lands on Punk Hazard and demands to know where Law is. Smoker tries stepping in to protect his G-5 marines.

episodes.name: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!
episodes.description: Stopping Tashigi in her tracks, Law faces the wrath of Smoker. Luffy’s group rides atop Brownbeard in a rush to catch up to the other Straw Hats.

episodes.name: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
episodes.description: Switching Tashigi and Smoker’s bodies, Law leaves the field of battle. The Straw Hats reassemble as an overjoyed samurai head reunites with his legs.

episodes.name: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!
episodes.description: Tashigi’s group is met by Vergo as they proceed to Block B, but his actions take them by surprise. Infuriated, Sanji takes it upon himself to wade in.

episodes.name: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook vs. the Mysterious Torso Samurai!
episodes.description: The G-5 marines pursue a distress call to the island. Elsewhere, Luffy's group gets a frosty reception, and Brook crosses swords with a living torso.

episodes.name: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats are stunned by Luffy’s response to Law. Meanwhile, Caesar Clown abandons his centaur to their fate and puts a slimy plan into action.

episodes.name: Z’s Ambition! Luffy vs. Shuzo!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats enjoy a moment of relief after escaping the battle, unaware that the Neo Marines have tailed them, prepared to fight to the death.

episodes.name: Get to Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance
episodes.description: The Straw Hats reach the lab, but a gaping hole in the wall threatens their survival. Using his Devil Fruit ability, Brook surveys the damage outside.

episodes.name: Tashigi's Tears! G-5's Desperate Breakthrough Plan!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats want to make their escape to Block R, but the marines won't let them through. As the stand-off continues, Caesar sends in the gas.

episodes.name: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro's Formidable One-Sword Style!
episodes.description: The battle in the Biscuit Room rages on as Zoro is joined by an unlikely ally. Sanji boosts the G-5 marines’ morale as they go rescue the children.

episodes.name: It's Time to Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!
episodes.description: The children wave an emotional farewell to the Straw Hats as they board the marines’ ship. Later, a proposal from Law ruffles Doflamingo’s feathers.

episodes.name: Arriving! A Burning Island – Punk Hazard!
episodes.description: The crew discover Punk Hazard, a curious island with erupting volcanoes. Luffy and three others elect to go ashore and investigate a distress call.

episodes.name: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!
episodes.description: The group’s evacuation is finally underway, but falling debris threatens to halt their advance. Elsewhere, Monet prepares to deliver the final blow.

episodes.name: Capture Caesar! General Cannon Blasts!
episodes.description: Under Doflamingo's orders, Baby 5 and Buffalo continue their assault on Franky. Not one to back down, Franky brings out his secret weapon.

episodes.name: Shocking! The True Identity of the Mystery Man Vergo!
episodes.description: When Luffy's group wakes up in the same cage as Law and Smoker, they're able to piece together who Vergo is, and who's behind the child kidnappings.

episodes.name: History’s Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea
episodes.description: While Luffy and his friends enjoy some tasty meat, a powerful creature attacks the dinner party, leading to a showdown with Luffy, Toriko and Goku.

episodes.name: Episode 1138
episodes.description: Although Kuma has pushed his body to the brink following his crushing blow on St. Saturn, he still approaches Bonney, much to Vegapunk's surprise.

episodes.name: Episode 1140
episodes.description: Amid the heavy shelling, the Pacifistas take aim at Kuma and the others. Atlas tells Bonney something that enables her to turn the tide of battle.

episodes.name: Episode 1127
episodes.description: As Luffy holds off Kizaru, Vegapunk and the other Straw Hats set out to regain control of the Pacifistas, rescue Bonney and escape from Egghead.

episodes.name: Episode 1128
episodes.description: As the Pacifistas begin attacking the Marines, Sanji and the others hurry down the island clouds toward the Fabriophase in search of Bonney.

episodes.name: Episode 1136
episodes.description: Bonney and her crew search for Kuma. Meanwhile, in the East Blue, the Straw Hats gain notoriety for defeating Arlong's gang of Fish-Man Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 1142
episodes.description: Caribou tells Catarina Devon and Van Augur he has powerful information that will prove useful to Blackbeard. The Marines close in on Bonney's group.

episodes.name: Episode 1152
episodes.description: Clover asks World Government researcher Vegapunk to help him study the Void Century. In the present, the Iron Giant robot offers Luffy its assistance.

episodes.name: Episode 1139
episodes.description: Despite Vegapunk's desperate plea, St. Saturn refuses to revoke the Buster Call. Bonney's group hurries to evacuate as the bombardment begins.

episodes.name: Episode 1149
episodes.description: Edison claims that the barrier is useless and urges Stussy to flee. Meanwhile, Vegapunk shares a stunning revelation about the history of the world.

episodes.name: Episode 1132
episodes.description: Following Ginny's abduction, Kuma continues fighting alongside the Revolutionary Army. Two years later, Ginny suddenly contacts Kuma and his comrades.

episodes.name: Episode 1146
episodes.description: Franky, Bonney and Atlas fight a group of Marine admirals. St. Mars in his bird form enlists York's help to find the source of the broadcast.

episodes.name: Episode 1134
episodes.description: Having eavesdropped on Vegapunk's conversation with Kuma, St. Saturn imposes some cruel conditions on them in return for treating Bonney's illness.

episodes.name: Episode 1147
episodes.description: Having infiltrated Punk Records to stop the broadcast, St. Mars comes face-to-face with Vegapunk's massive brain. St. Nusjuro corners Bonney's group.

episodes.name: Episode 1137
episodes.description: Having seen all of Kuma's memories, Bonney realizes she misunderstood Vegapunk. In the present, she attempts to strike back at St. Saturn.

episodes.name: Episode 1144
episodes.description: Hell-bent on preventing Vegapunk's broadcast from revealing the truth about the world, the other four Elders arrive on Egghead in monstrous forms.

episodes.name: Episode 1145
episodes.description: In his giant bird form, St. Mars appears before an embattled Lucci. Soon after, Dorry gives the signal for his allies to begin their escape.

episodes.name: Episode 1125
episodes.description: Kizaru and Sentomaru's fierce battle continues. As the marines make landfall, Dr. Vegapunk and his Satellites desperately work to crack the code.

episodes.name: Episode 1131
episodes.description: Kuma lives as a pastor with Ginny in Sorbet Kingdom and heals the older residents. Years later, the king begins forcing people into servitude.

episodes.name: Episode 1133
episodes.description: Kuma resists King Bekori's tyranny and overthrows him single-handedly. At the citizens' insistence, Kuma accepts the throne of the Sorbet Kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 1141
episodes.description: Led by Dorry and Brogy, the Giant Pirate Crew attacks the Marines. The Straw Hats continue preparing to escape but still face some daunting obstacles.

episodes.name: Episode 1148
episodes.description: People around the world realize Vegapunk's predictions were correct. Meanwhile, the Five Elders go all out in a bid to cut off the transmission.

episodes.name: Episode 1130
episodes.description: Pirates invade God Valley after hearing about the Local-Hunting Competition. Kuma and his friends set out to steal the Devil Fruit prizes and escape.

episodes.name: Episode 1126
episodes.description: Sakazuki attempts to thwart Kuma's assault on Mary Geoise. In the present, Luffy continues trying to prevent Kizaru from reaching Vegapunk.

episodes.name: Episode 1123
episodes.description: Six days after Lulusia's destruction, an earthquake causes chaos throughout the world. Meanwhile, Admiral Kizaru's forces have surrounded Egghead.

episodes.name: Episode 1150
episodes.description: The Five Elders begin moving toward the Iron Giant. When the barrier around the island goes down, Nami and the others hurriedly prepare to set sail.

episodes.name: Episode 1151
episodes.description: The Five Elders move to eliminate the Vegapunks Lilith and Atlas. On the Giant Pirates' ship, a fired-up Luffy encourages Bonney to attain a new form.

episodes.name: Episode 1154
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and Giant Pirates depart Egghead and set sail for Elbaph. Two weeks earlier, Vegapunk learns one of his Satellites has betrayed him.

episodes.name: Episode 1135
episodes.description: Three years prior, while watching Luffy train, Kuma recalls a conversation he had with Dragon. Bonney waits impatiently for a letter from Kuma.

episodes.name: Episode 1129
episodes.description: Unfazed by Bonney's attack, St. Saturn overwhelms her and the others. In the past, a young Kuma and his parents are captured by government agents.

episodes.name: Episode 1124
episodes.description: Using York as a bargaining chip, Luffy tries forcing a deal with the marines to let the Straw Hats leave Egghead. Both groups plan their next move.

episodes.name: Episode 1153
episodes.description: Vegapunk's message gets pirates throughout the world fired up to find the One Piece, but the Five Elders finally manage to stop the transmission.

episodes.name: Episode 1143
episodes.description: With bated breath, people around the world tune in to Vegapunk's pre-recorded broadcast. Meanwhile, Dragon recalls something that Shaka told him.

episodes.name: Episode 1155
episodes.description: York sees Edison carry out a sneaky move but is unable to stop him. St. Saturn meets with a grisly fate and is replaced by a formidable new Elder.

episodes.name: Episode 336
episodes.description: An evil scientist takes over a TV station in order to recruit better henchmen for himself. Chopperman faces financial difficulties.

episodes.name: Episode 334
episodes.description: As Don Accino grows ever hotter by getting steaming mad, Luffy smashes him with a chunk of ice. Puzzle makes a comeback.

episodes.name: Episode 335
episodes.description: Lava starts to rise to the surface as Don Accino continues to melt all the ice around him. Luffy faces Don Accino surrounded by a field of lava.

episodes.name: Episode 329
episodes.description: Nami and Franky discover a massive group of angry penguins when they dive into the sea to find out what is moving the iceberg in front of them.

episodes.name: Episode 331
episodes.description: Nami and Franky get transported to their enemy's stronghold in their frozen submarine. Sanji and Usopp are also caught after falling into icy waters.

episodes.name: Episode 333
episodes.description: The Accino Family attacks Luffy and the others upon their arrival in Lovely Land. Chopper tries not to get frozen solid by the enemy.

episodes.name: Episode 330
episodes.description: The Accino Family attacks the Straw Hats while they are separated. Robin agrees to play with a little girl that showed up on the Sunny.

episodes.name: Episode 328
episodes.description: The Phoenix Pirates had lost their flag to the Accino Family. After waking up, Captain Puzzle declares that his crew will quit their pirate ways.

episodes.name: Episode 326
episodes.description: The Straw Hats offer assistance to a group of fishermen. The captain gives them a barrel of booze as a token of thanks, but it puts everyone to sleep.

episodes.name: Episode 327
episodes.description: The Straw Hats play right into the hands of the Accino Family as they transform the Sunny and zoom out of the way of the Marines.

episodes.name: Episode 332
episodes.description: Zoro tries to attack Don Accino without making contact when he learns that he is a Devil Fruit user who has the power to melt anything he touches.

episodes.name: Episode 202
episodes.description: Another bunch of Marines await at the dock. Luffy and the others take out many of them, but the vast number of foes is daunting.

episodes.name: Episode 205
episodes.description: Luffy and Nami crash right into the enemy's lair. When Luffy gets captured, Nami is left to deal with the Marines and get the gold back by herself.

episodes.name: Episode 199
episodes.description: Luffy and Sanji decide to run away after being recognized. Usopp dresses up as a Marine and heads to the dock where the Going Merry is being kept.

episodes.name: Episode 200
episodes.description: Luffy and Sanji encounter Marines and a heavily fortified prison when they get to a suspicious looking island in search of Zoro and Usopp.

episodes.name: Episode 197
episodes.description: Luffy and Sanji get mistaken as the cooks scheduled to arrive at the base the same day. The head chef challenges Sanji to a cook-off.

episodes.name: Episode 201
episodes.description: Luffy and the others head for the dock where the Going Merry is, but they must cross a bridge full of Marines in order to get there.

episodes.name: Episode 204
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp and Robin stand before a giant vault. While Luffy and the others deal with the Marines, Usopp figures out how to open the vault.

episodes.name: Episode 198
episodes.description: Nami escapes into a closet and changes into a nurse's uniform. Chopper gets wheeled off to the medical room inside a wooden crate.

episodes.name: Episode 196
episodes.description: The Going Merry lands inside a naval fortress. When no one is discovered aboard the ship, the Marines begin to fear it may be a ghost ship.

episodes.name: Episode 206
episodes.description: The Going Merry runs aground due to low tide. The Straw Hats are told to surrender peacefully, but they refuse to go down without a fight.

episodes.name: Episode 203
episodes.description: The Straw Hats make a U-turn and hide in an abandoned dock. They need the gold that the Marines stole from them to repair the Going Merry.

episodes.name: Finally, It’s Over! The Climax of the Intense Fight Against Katakuri!
episodes.description: As Big Mom's children wait for Luffy to emerge from the mirror, Sanji and Pudding reflect on their relationship. Luffy and Katakuri end their fight.

episodes.name: A Captivating Flavor! Sanji’s Cake of Happiness!
episodes.description: Big Mom finally indulges in her wedding cake while everyone on the island watches nervously to see if it will end her ravenous rampage at last.

episodes.name: Lurking in the Darkness! An Assassin Targeting Luffy!
episodes.description: Hiding in the shadows, Flampe interferes in Luffy and Katakuri's fight. The Sunny sails to Cacao Island despite the huge enemy force that awaits.

episodes.name: One Man’s Determination! Katakuri’s Deadly Big Fight!
episodes.description: Katakuri notices Flampe's actions and rages at her meddling. Unable to take pride in a lopsided duel, he takes drastic action to make it a fair fight.

episodes.name: Wake Up! The Color of Observation Able To Top the Strongest!
episodes.description: Katakuri recognizes Luffy's improvement before the two trade fierce blows. Luffy remembers his training with Rayleigh and tries to put it to use.

episodes.name: Finally, They Clash! The Emperor of the Sea vs. the Straw Hats!
episodes.description: Katakuri stays one step ahead of Luffy, who tries to gather his focus. Aboard the Sunny, the flaming-haired Big Mom searches for her wedding cake.

episodes.name: Dark King’s Direct Precepts! The Battle Against Katakuri Turns Around!
episodes.description: Katakuri's sister Flampe watches the battle between her brother and Luffy and plans to get involved. Luffy recalls Rayleigh's words about fighting.

episodes.name: A Fist of Divine Speed! Another Gear-Four Application Activated!
episodes.description: Luffy activates a new form of Gear Fourth to power his punches with incredible speed and agility, prompting a vicious response from Katakuri.

episodes.name: Finally He Returns! Sanji, the Man Who’ll Stop the Emperor of the Sea!
episodes.description: Luffy sees some progress in his ability to read Katakuri's attacks. Sanji puts the finishing touches on Big Mom's cake as she heads toward the Sunny.

episodes.name: The Man of Humanity and Justice! Jinbe, a Desperate Massive Ocean Current!
episodes.description: The Big Mom Pirates believe they're watching the Sunny sink, but a clever trick from a surprise helper means the Straw Hats' fate isn't sealed yet.

episodes.name: The Parting Time! Pudding’s Last Wish!
episodes.description: The Sunny heads out of Big Mom's territory while the Straw Hats tend to their physical and emotional wounds. The fighting closes out on Cacao Island.

episodes.name: A Desperate Situation! The Iron-Tight Entrapment of Luffy!
episodes.description: The Sunny nears the coast of Cacao Island. Pekoms and Luffy race toward the mirror and run into the Big Mom Pirates' trap — but they have a plan.

episodes.name: The Last Hope! The Sun Pirates Emerge!
episodes.description: The relieved crew of the Sunny welcome Sanji and the exhausted Luffy aboard. Big Mom nears her cake while her pirates ponder the possible outcomes.

episodes.name: Pulling Back From the Brink! The Formidable Reinforcements, Germa!
episodes.description: With Oven and his army caught off guard, unexpected reinforcements join the fight, allowing Sanji and Luffy to make a quick dash for the Sunny.

episodes.name: Episode 282
episodes.description: As Sanji and Chopper remember the people who helped them in the past, they think to themselves that they will never let Robin be lonely again.

episodes.name: Episode 278
episodes.description: As the sole survivor of the destruction of Ohara, eight-year-old Robin becomes a wanted fugitive. Back in the present, Luffy calls out to Robin.

episodes.name: Episode 264
episodes.description: As they approach Enies Lobby, Luffy and the others discuss their plan to have the Straw Hats charge in after Galley-La and the Franky Family members.

episodes.name: Episode 284
episodes.description: Franky reveals the ancient weapon blueprints to Spandam and burns them before his eyes. The stuck drawbridge is used as a launching pad for Rocketman.

episodes.name: Episode 274
episodes.description: Franky takes Robin to a balcony overlooking the rooftop where Luffy is. One after another, the other Straw Hat Pirates arrive.

episodes.name: Episode 265
episodes.description: Luffy speeds past the gates and heads to the main island. Galley-La and the Franky Family start making way for Rocketman to charge through.

episodes.name: Episode 268
episodes.description: Nami uses her Perfect Clima Tact to strike down all of the enemies around her with lightning. The five Straw Hats run to catch up with their captain.

episodes.name: Episode 269
episodes.description: Robin had cooperated with CP9 in order to guarantee safety for her friends. But the treacherous Spandam means to send them to a prison stronghold.

episodes.name: Episode 276
episodes.description: Robin's mother Olvia escapes prison to warn about the navy's plan to get rid of the island scholars. Unknowingly, Robin passes by her mother in town.

episodes.name: Episode 270
episodes.description: Sogeking listens and connects the dots as the sobbing Oimo tells him his story: Oimo and Kashii had served under none other than Dorry and Broggy.

episodes.name: Episode 275
episodes.description: Spandam threatens to initiate a Buster Call, the very thing that tragically wiped Robin's hometown off the map 20 years ago.

episodes.name: Episode 273
episodes.description: Steam rises from Luffy's body as he activates his new fighting technique Second Gear. With explosive power, Luffy smashes through Blueno's defenses.

episodes.name: Episode 277
episodes.description: Tears stream down Robin's face as she begs to be with Olvia after realizing that the woman being taken away by CP9 is her mother.

episodes.name: Episode 283
episodes.description: The Straw Hats had originally gone to Water Seven with the intention of recruiting a shipwright, but what awaited them was something else entirely.

episodes.name: Episode 279
episodes.description: The Straw Hats start their rescue operation, but the drawbridge that leads to Robin gets stuck. Luffy remembers the day he decided to go out to sea.

episodes.name: Episode 267
episodes.description: The gate finally opens after Paulie uses his ropes to defeat Oimo. With help from Yokozuna, the Rocketman takes off into the sky.

episodes.name: Episode 266
episodes.description: The king bulls join the Franky Family's fight against the giants guarding the gate. The members of CP9 gather together at the Tower of Law.

episodes.name: Episode 281
