episodes.description: The loneliness that Robin had hidden in the deepest recesses of her heart stirs up Nami's memories of once betraying Luffy and the others.

episodes.name: Episode 272
episodes.description: With reports of over 2,000 casualties, Enies Lobby experiences the worst crisis in its entire history at the hands of the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 280
episodes.description: Zoro also reflects back on his past during the rescue mission. Even as he was being held captive, he could not forget a certain promise he made.

episodes.name: Episode 271
episodes.description: Zoro and the others head out to Luffy's location after joining the Franky Family on Gomorrah, but Gomorrah is also struck down by unknown assailants.

episodes.name: A Secret Meeting! Luffy vs. the Firetank Pirates!
episodes.description: At Jimbei’s suggestion, the Straw Hats arrive at Capone Bege’s hideout to discuss joining forces. Nami speaks with Lola’s twin sister Chiffon.

episodes.name: The Family Gets Together! The Hellish Tea Party Starts!
episodes.description: Bege performs security checks in front of the tea party venue. When a guest refuses to comply, Sweet General Katakuri demonstrates his strength.

episodes.name: The Mission Failed?! The Big Mom Pirates Strike Back!
episodes.description: Brook successfully smashes the photo of Mother Carmel, but Big Mom does not start screaming. Her children attempt to regain control of the situation.

episodes.name: Returning the Sake Cup! The Manly Jinbe Pays His Debt!
episodes.description: Dozens of fake Luffys emerge from the wedding cake and wreak havoc on the tea party. Jimbei decides to deliver a formal announcement to Big Mom.

episodes.name: The Rendezvous! Luffy, a One-on-One at His Limit!
episodes.description: In his weakened state, Luffy takes a beating as he waits for Sanji. Brook startles Nami and the others by pulling a certain item out of his head.

episodes.name: A Deadly Kiss! The Mission To Assassinate the Emperor Kicks Off!
episodes.description: Jimbei tries to wake Luffy as the tea party begins. The wedding guests watch Sanji and Pudding when the time comes for him to lift her veil.

episodes.name: A Liar! Luffy and Sanji!
episodes.description: Luffy eats for the first time in days after he and Sanji are finally reunited. However, Sanji doubles down on his refusal to return to the crew.

episodes.name: Luffy Engages in a Secret Maneuver! The Wedding Full of Conspiracies Starts Soon!
episodes.description: Luffy’s excitement grows as the meeting with Bege continues. Suspecting that Sanji is betraying Big Mom, Charlotte Montd’Or visits Sanji’s room.

episodes.name: The Emperor Rolls Over! Rescue Brook Mission!
episodes.description: Nami and the others locate Brook in Big Mom’s bedroom using the Mirro-World. But saving him without waking Big Mom up proves quite the challenge.

episodes.name: Run, Sanji! SOS! Germa 66!
episodes.description: Sanji runs with all his might to rescue his family. Katakuri obstructs Luffy as he attempts to show the broken photo to Big Mom once more.

episodes.name: The Broken Couple! Sanji and Pudding Enter!
episodes.description: Sanji tries to stay cool in the face of Pudding’s beauty. Meanwhile, Bege and his crew carry out final preparations for the assassination plot.

episodes.name: The Deadly Pact! Luffy and Bege’s Allied Forces!
episodes.description: Serving as arbitrator, Jimbei helps bring Luffy and Bege together. A surprise guest who has a history with the Straw Hats participates in the meeting.

episodes.name: Sanji Comes Back! Crash! The Tea Party From Hell!
episodes.description: Using a shard of glass, Luffy tells the crew in the Mirro-World that he plans to crash the wedding. Jimbei speaks of a plot surrounding Big Mom.

episodes.name: The Rebellious Daughter, Chiffon! Sanji’s Big Plan for Transporting the Cake!
episodes.description: Big Mom spots Luffy on Nuts Island and diverts her rampage toward him. Sanji and the group on Cacao Island begin transporting the cake to the Sunny.

episodes.name: The End of the Deadly Battle?! Katakuri’s Awakening in Anger!
episodes.description: In the face of Katakuri's superior abilities, Luffy grows exhausted. Frustrated that Luffy keeps evading his attacks, Katakuri steps things up.

episodes.name: A Hard Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Katakuri!
episodes.description: Katakuri aims to break Luffy's spirit with his more powerful arsenal of attacks. Sanji, Chiffon and Pudding boldly prepare to make the cake they need.

episodes.name: The Forbidden Secret! Katakuri’s Merienda!
episodes.description: Katakuri leaves Luffy under a pile of mochi to go satisfy his appetite with some ritualistic eating. With Katakuri's guard down, Luffy makes a move.

episodes.name: Sulong! Carrot’s Big Mystic Transformation!
episodes.description: Luffy and Katakuri restart their clash in the Mirro-World. Meanwhile, Big Mom's fleet surrounds the Sunny as it sails straight toward Daifuku's ships.

episodes.name: The Man With a Bounty of a Billion! The Strongest Sweet General, Katakuri!
episodes.description: Luffy battles ferociously with a confident Katakuri in the Mirro-World. The others on the Sunny reflect on the sacrifice made to ensure their escape.

episodes.name: Break Through! The Straw Hat’s Mighty Sea Battle!
episodes.description: Luffy continues to take a beating at the hands of Katakuri but refuses to stay down. Bege wants to add poison to Big Mom's cake, but Sanji protests.

episodes.name: The Threat of the Mole! Luffy’s Silent Fight!
episodes.description: Luffy orders his crew to break the mirrors on the Sunny — despite them being his best chance of escape — and faces a barrage of attacks from Katakuri.

episodes.name: Luffy Fights Back! The Invincible Katakuri’s Weak Point!
episodes.description: Luffy starts to understand Katakuri's fighting style more clearly and begins his counterattack, hitting him with a succession of massive blows.

episodes.name: The Green Room! An Invincible Helmsman, Jinbe!
episodes.description: Luffy tries to stop his enemies from shooting fiery arrows through the mirror and into the Sunny, while Big Mom's ships fire a hail of cannonballs.

episodes.name: A Man’s Way of Life! Bege and Luffy’s Determination As Captains!
episodes.description: Oven holds an anxious Chiffon captive at the port and demands Bege's surrender. Bege and his fleet approach the coast for a compelling confrontation.

episodes.name: The Cake Sank?! Sanji and Bege’s Getaway Battle!
episodes.description: Sanji tries to land the cake on the Nostra Castello. The ship makes its way to safety through the town, but Oven still stands in its path.

episodes.name: I’ll Be Back! Luffy’s Deadly Departure
episodes.description: The Straw Hats prepare to make their escape in the aftermath of Pedro's explosion. Luffy must keep Katakuri occupied to prevent him from interfering.

episodes.name: Another Crisis! Gear Four vs. Unstoppable Donuts!
episodes.description: When Katakuri forces the tide of battle back in his favor, Luffy has to retreat. Big Mom arrives on Nuts Island in her crazed search for wedding cake.

episodes.name: Episode 74
episodes.description: Broggy finds out who placed the bomb in Dorry's drink. Mr. 3 captures Broggy and sets Vivi, Zoro and Nami on a giant candle display.

episodes.name: Episode 71
episodes.description: Broggy the giant asks for a drink from Nami and Usopp, while Luffy is saved by another giant named Dorry. The two giants clash in a century-old feud.

episodes.name: Episode 68
episodes.description: Coby continues to work toward his dream as he works at a Marine base with Morgan's son Helmeppo. While being handed over, Morgan runs away from Garp.

episodes.name: Episode 63
episodes.description: Fifty years have passed since Laboon was left in Crocus's care. Laboon rams his head against the Red Line as he waits for his friends to return.

episodes.name: Episode 69
episodes.description: Luffy learns from a newspaper that Coby is in the Grand Line. Garp makes a discovery about Coby as he oversees his training with Helmeppo.

episodes.name: Episode 76
episodes.description: Mr. 3 goes on the offensive after Usopp snaps Luffy back to his senses. Usopp and Karoo prepare a rope as a wick to light the giant candle display.

episodes.name: Episode 66
episodes.description: Mr. 9 fights to protect Vivi from Mr. 5 and Ms. Valentine. Igaram begs Zoro to escort Vivi safely back to her kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 67
episodes.description: Nami stops the fight between fists and swords. Luffy agrees to help Vivi after learning about the Baroque Works' plan to take over her kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 77
episodes.description: Tears stream out of Broggy's eyes like waterfalls as he mourns his fallen rival. Sanji speaks to Mr. 0 at Mr. 3's hideout.

episodes.name: Episode 64
episodes.description: The Going Merry heads to an island with Mr. 9 and Ms. Wednesday. To their surprise, the Straw Hats receive a grand welcome from the islanders.

episodes.name: Episode 70
episodes.description: The Straw Hats arrive at Little Garden, their second stop in the Grand Line. Luffy and Vivi go exploring and encounter a dinosaur on the island.

episodes.name: Episode 62
episodes.description: The Straw Hats meet a lighthouse keeper named Crocus after the Going Merry is swallowed whole by a giant island whale called Laboon.

episodes.name: Episode 72
episodes.description: Usopp stares in awe as the two giants fight over their honor. Dorry blames the Straw Hats when the drink he received from them explodes.

episodes.name: Episode 73
episodes.description: Zoro and Nami disappear in the jungle while the giants continue their fight. Broggy moves in to strike when Dorry loses his footing on Mr. 3's wax.

episodes.name: Episode 75
episodes.description: Zoro and the others get covered in wax faster after Luffy takes action. Luffy gets hypnotized and rejects the idea of helping his friends.

episodes.name: Episode 65
episodes.description: Zoro takes his new swords out on a test run against a mob of bounty hunters. After facing Ms. Monday, Zoro deals with Mr. 8.

episodes.name: Episode 379
episodes.description: Brook recalls a time when he had some meat on his bones and Laboon was still little. The Rumbar Pirates bond with Laboon through music.

episodes.name: Episode 380
episodes.description: Brook shares the song he and his crewmates recorded for Laboon before they all died. From then until now, Brook had led a lonely existence.

episodes.name: Episode 339
episodes.description: Brook urges Luffy and the others to turn around and get away from the ghost island Thriller Bark, but Luffy fully intends to disembark.

episodes.name: Episode 363
episodes.description: Chopper gets furious at Hogback for playing with people's lives. After revealing his history with Cindry, Hogback tells her to kill Chopper and Robin.

episodes.name: Episode 359
episodes.description: Despite meeting Absalom for the first time in his life, Sanji resents his foe many times over for ruining his childhood dream for good.

episodes.name: Episode 352
episodes.description: Five years after figuring out that zombies are vulnerable to salt, Brook challenges Ryuma to a duel again in order to get his shadow back.

episodes.name: Episode 354
episodes.description: For 50 years, Brook has been fighting to fulfill his promise to see Laboon again. Luffy and the others recall their encounter with the giant whale.

episodes.name: Episode 368
episodes.description: Franky suggests docking again, but Robin refuses to participate. Giving up on his initial plan, Franky charges Oars with just Usopp and Chopper.

episodes.name: Episode 381
episodes.description: From the bottom of his heart, Brook is ecstatic to still be alive; being alive means he will one day be able to reunite with Laboon.

episodes.name: Episode 378
episodes.description: Hogback and Absalom flee Thriller Bark on a ship with Moria. The Straw Hats throw a feast for everyone to celebrate getting their shadows back.

episodes.name: Episode 377
episodes.description: In the aftermath of battle, Kuma approaches an unconscious Luffy. Zoro intervenes and reveals Kuma's true nature before agreeing to a grim deal.

episodes.name: Episode 376
episodes.description: Kuma deflects the attacks of his enemies using his Devil Fruit powers. Sanji hurts his own leg by kicking Kuma's incredibly hard head.

episodes.name: Episode 348
episodes.description: Lola catches up to Nami and lunges to skewer her with her two swords. Luffy gets brought before Moria after being let out of the coffin.

episodes.name: Episode 345
episodes.description: Lola the warthog zombie tries to force Absalom's hand in marriage. When Absalom tells her about Nami, Lola charges out to eliminate her rival.

episodes.name: Episode 343
episodes.description: Luffy and the others easily defeat the zombies in the graveyard. A gravely injured old man who looks like a zombie stops the crew to talk to them.

episodes.name: Episode 356
episodes.description: Luffy and the others get to the dancehall where his shadow was taken from him. Chopper stops Luffy when he tries to punch Hogback.

episodes.name: Episode 360
episodes.description: Luffy continues to struggle fighting against Moria's shadow. Perona sticks her hands into Usopp's chest after flying around to dodge his attacks.

episodes.name: Episode 355
episodes.description: Luffy heads to defeat Moria in order to get his shadow back. Sanji gets fired up about rescuing Nami while Zoro and Franky decide to help Brook.

episodes.name: Episode 338
episodes.description: Luffy takes an immediate liking to Brook and welcomes him aboard the Sunny, where the living skeleton reveals that he is a Devil Fruit user.

episodes.name: Episode 350
episodes.description: Luffy's shadow combined with Hogback's 900th zombie will make the strongest zombie ever to exist. Moria and the others head to a special freezer.

episodes.name: Episode 351
episodes.description: Luffy's shadow is planted inside the remains of the legendary warrior Oars. Shaking off the frost from his body, Oars finally rises again.

episodes.name: Episode 375
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, Robin and Captain Lola start to catch fire in the morning sun. Before the dust has a chance to settle, Kuma appears.

episodes.name: Episode 373
episodes.description: Moria has to tell the stolen shadows to go back to their owners. With sunrise fast approaching, Moria must somehow be forced to say the words.

episodes.name: Episode 344
episodes.description: Nami and the others are caught snooping on Hogback in his lab. Samurai Ryuma shows up and cracks a weirdly familiar mummy joke.

episodes.name: Episode 342
episodes.description: Nami and the others discover that Cindry had died in an accident 10 years ago when they escape into a room that is covered with her photos.

episodes.name: Episode 340
episodes.description: Nami and the others ride a carriage to Dr. Hogback's mansion through a creepy forest full of strange, otherworldly creatures.

episodes.name: Episode 353
episodes.description: Nami gets her wedding dress picked out. On the Sunny, Luffy and the others discuss their strategy to get their shadows and Nami back.

episodes.name: Episode 364
episodes.description: Oars accepts Moria as his master and starts attacking Luffy in order to fulfill his task of crushing the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.name: Episode 371
episodes.description: Oars can now stretch his body with the help of Moria's Devil Fruit powers. Robin tries to stop Oars by going after Moria himself.

episodes.name: Episode 366
episodes.description: Oars continues looking for the rest of his targets after crushing Sanji and the others. Nami wakes up in the middle of Absalom's wedding ceremony.

episodes.name: Episode 358
episodes.description: Only Moria has the power to restore a shadow to its rightful place. Luffy struggles to land a single blow on Moria due to his shadowy powers.

episodes.name: Episode 347
episodes.description: Robin and Franky encounter a hostile giant spider monkey. Fueled by jealous rage, Lola comes after Nami for taking Absalom away from her.

episodes.name: Episode 346
episodes.description: Sanji and Zoro disappear. Luffy and the others encounter a general zombie that refuses to stay down. Someone who fights like Zoro attacks Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 367
episodes.description: Sanji and the others decide to go with Zoro's idea to send the enormous Oars flying. Oars comes up with a new technique to attack his enemies.

episodes.name: Episode 341
episodes.description: Something attacks Nami while she's bathing. Nami's hunch proves to be right when she and the others discover that the mansion is full of zombies.

episodes.name: Episode 349
episodes.description: Something black comes out of the giant spider monkey's mouth. Brook reveals what he knows about zombies from his past experiences at Thriller Bark.

episodes.name: Episode 337
episodes.description: The Straw Hats spot a barrel floating in the ocean. When they open it, a red flash of light fills the sky and the crew gets caught in a sudden storm.

episodes.name: Episode 374
episodes.description: The sun is rising, but Captain Lola does not run away. The Straw Hats set a valiant example by not giving up as they face down the powered up Moria.

episodes.name: Episode 357
episodes.description: Try as she might, Perona's Devil Fruit powers have no effect on Usopp. Usopp, on the other hand, is not sure he can handle so many zombies on his own.

episodes.name: Episode 361
episodes.description: Usopp takes aim at Perona's defenseless shell of a body. Chopper and Robin have difficulties fighting the dog penguin creature and Jigoro.

episodes.name: Episode 370
episodes.description: Zoro and the others attack Moria and Oars with everything they have to little effect. Oars strikes back with one of Luffy's signature moves.

episodes.name: Episode 372
episodes.description: Zoro buys time for Usopp to use the big bag of salt against Oars, but Moria's shadow takes the bag right back out of his mouth.

episodes.name: Episode 365
episodes.description: Zoro calls down to Chopper and the others from the roof. While rushing to get back to Nami's side, Sanji runs right into Oars.

episodes.name: Episode 369
episodes.description: Zoro decides to take Oars head on to test out the new sword he obtained from Ryuma. Bartholomew Kuma meets with Moria face-to-face.

episodes.name: Episode 362
episodes.description: Zoro falls as Ryuma watches, engulfed in blue flames. Both Brook and Franky are baffled and confused about what they have just witnessed.

episodes.name: The Time Limit Closes In! The Bond Between the Mink Tribe and the Crew!
episodes.description: Caesar Clown reveals that he created the poisonous gas that was unleashed on the Mink tribe. Sanji’s group surveys the aftermath of the cruel attack.

episodes.name: Let’s Go and Meet Master Cat Viper!
episodes.description: Continuing their journey, the Straw Hats decide to ask Pekoms where Sanji went but are suddenly attacked by a swarm of flying, blood-sucking bugs.

episodes.name: A Red Stone! A Guide to the One Piece!
episodes.description: Disappointed by Raizo’s appearance, the Straw Hats pester him to act like a stereotypical ninja. A crest and an ancient stone catch Robin’s attention.

episodes.name: The Delinquent Comes Home! Emperor Big Mom’s Assassins!
episodes.description: En route to meet Cat Viper, Brook explains what happened to Sanji and how Pekoms of the Big Mom Pirates reached Zou to find his homeland destroyed.

episodes.name: A Vow Between Two Men! Luffy and Kozuki Momonosuke!
episodes.description: Kin’emon asks Luffy and his crew for help in the fight against the pirates that destroyed Wano. Luffy shocks everyone by declining his request.

episodes.name: The Third One! Raizo of the Mist, the Ninja, Appears!
episodes.description: Kin’emon thanks the Mink tribe for going so far to protect Raizo. To everyone’s shock, Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop fighting at Momonosuke’s behest.

episodes.name: Luffy’s Decision! Sanji on the Brink of Quitting!
episodes.description: Pekoms tells the crew that if Sanji refuses the marriage, someone he knows will be killed. Angry, Luffy orders Pekoms to take him to the wedding.

episodes.name: To My Buds! Sanji’s Farewell Note!
episodes.description: Sanji gives a letter to Nami and says he needs to deal with something from his past. He then uses Caesar as a bargaining chip to set his friends free.

episodes.name: The Secret of the Land of Wano! The Kozuki Family and the Ponegliffs!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats learn that the Road Ponegliffs reveal the location of an island called Laugh Tale. But accessing the remaining stones won’t be easy.

episodes.name: A Volatile Situation! The Dog and the Cat and the Samurai!
episodes.description: The arrival of Kin’emon and Kanjuro sends the Mokomo Dukedom into an uproar. The Straw Hats rush to send them back to the Sunny before they are found.

episodes.name: The Truth Behind the Disappearance! Sanji Gets a Startling Invitation!
episodes.description: Underlings emerge from Capone Bege’s body and surround Sanji and Brook. The situation turns from bad to worse when Nami and Chopper are taken hostage.

episodes.name: The Nightmare Returns! The Invincible Jack’s Fierce Attack!
episodes.description: Cat Viper surprises the group by saying that he has an idea of where Marco disappeared to. Luffy, however, needs help remembering who Marco is.

episodes.name: Save Zunesha! The Straw Hat’s Rescue Operation!
episodes.description: Chopper requests the crew dress Zunesha’s injured leg before departure. The Straw Hats and the Mink tribe band together to assist with treatment.

episodes.name: A Hungry Front! Luffy and the Navy Rookies!
episodes.description: Due to Luffy exhausting their provisions, the Straw Hats invade a marine base to procure some food. A new naval captain arrives and stirs up trouble.

episodes.name: Saying Goodbye and Descending From the Elephant! Setting Out To Take Back Sanji!
episodes.description: Finished with Zunesha’s treatment, the alliance members split into groups and prepare to go their separate ways. Pedro stays with the Straw Hats.

episodes.name: The Implacable Three! A Big Chase After the Straw Hats!
episodes.description: Luffy and Carrot are pursued by marines after being caught eating food in the cafeteria. Meanwhile, Nami and Chopper break into the food warehouse.

episodes.name: Kaido Returns! An Imminent Threat to the Worst Generation!
episodes.description: Luffy grows concerned for his brother Sabo after hearing that the Revolutionary Army headquarters has been destroyed by the Blackbeard Pirates.

episodes.name: The Devil’s Fist! A Showdown! Luffy vs. Grount!
episodes.description: Luffy’s group must defeat Vice Admiral Prodi to reach the Thousand Sunny. After the skirmish, a reinvigorated Grount challenges Luffy to a rematch.

episodes.name: A Battle To Defend Zou! Luffy and Zunesha!
episodes.description: Panic ensues among the Mink tribe as the elephant begins to sway. A booming voice then reaches out to Momonosuke and asks him to give an order.

episodes.name: To the Reverie! Princess Vivi and Princess Shirahoshi!
episodes.description: Princess Vivi enthusiastically takes to the sea for the World Summit being held in Mary Geoise. On the way, she reflects on her time with Luffy.

episodes.name: The Legendary Journey! The Dog and the Cat and the Pirate King!
episodes.description: The Mink tribe is overjoyed by Dogstorm and Cat Viper’s rekindled friendship. Meanwhile, Jack reveals a bold plan to his crew as they approach Zou.

episodes.name: To the Reverie! Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats welcome an enthusiastic Carrot after her surprise appearance. Dalton prepares to represent the Sakura Kingdom at the World Summit.

episodes.name: Episode 288
episodes.description: Chimney guides Luffy to an underwater passage that leads to the Gates of Justice. Nami heads up the stairs to Kalifa's room. Franky takes on Fukuro.

episodes.name: Episode 290
episodes.description: Chopper decides to take his second Rumble Ball in his fight against Kumadori, but it makes it difficult for him to control his transformations.

episodes.name: Episode 295
episodes.description: Chopper in his monstrously huge form inadvertently gives Nami a hint. Realizing what her enemy's weakness is, Nami sets her plan in motion.

episodes.name: Episode 304
episodes.description: Enies Lobby gets bombarded by cannon fire. Luffy has trouble keeping up with Lucci's overwhelming strength as he continues to fight against him.

episodes.name: Episode 305
episodes.description: Fifteen years ago, the 13-year-old Lucci was sent into a kingdom overtaken by pirates. There, he killed their captain along with all the hostages.

episodes.name: Episode 289
episodes.description: Franky plummets straight down toward the waterfalls after being tackled by Fukuro. Zoro ruins Usopp's plan to have Kaku and Jabra destroy each other.

episodes.name: Episode 294
episodes.description: In a panicked state after hearing Luffy's voice approaching, Spandam accidentally activates the golden switch and sets a Buster Call in motion.

episodes.name: Episode 303
episodes.description: It is now spring; the cherry blossoms are in full bloom. Boss Luffy tries to think of a way to allow a sick boy to see the flowers like everyone else.

episodes.name: Episode 291
episodes.description: It is the grand old days. A certain hooved doctor has been too busy to visit Sanji and Nami's eatery lately, but Luffy has been a regular fixture.

episodes.name: Episode 298
episodes.description: Jabra uses his hardening technique against Sanji. Sanji's leg burns with fiery rage as he prepares to strike at Jabra for making Robin suffer.

episodes.name: Episode 300
episodes.description: Kaku makes full use of his powerful limbs and neck against Zoro, but in that moment, Zoro suddenly takes on the appearance of a vengeful demon god.

episodes.name: Episode 293
episodes.description: Kalifa blocks Nami's attack with a bubble barrier. Controlling her soapy bubbles, the Devil Fruit user washes the strength off her enemies.

episodes.name: Episode 296
episodes.description: Nami and Franky rush to the upper level to stop the rampaging Chopper. The only way to turn him back to normal might be to dunk him into the ocean.

episodes.name: Episode 302
episodes.description: Navy cannon fire interrupts the momentary relief of Robin's freedom. Sogeking dives from the Tower of Law to avoid taking a direct hit.

episodes.name: Episode 301
episodes.description: Robin desperately tries to buy time for her friends, but Spandam drags her to the Gates of Justice. Just then, someone shoots Spandam from afar.

episodes.name: Episode 292
episodes.description: Sanji and the others are running around town with a cart at the start of the new year, when a shady-looking bunch suddenly stops them in their tracks.

episodes.name: Episode 297
episodes.description: Sogeking gets injured after allowing himself to believe that the deceitful Jabra would give up his key without a fight. Nami runs to his side.

episodes.name: Episode 299
episodes.description: Spandam stands before the Gates of Justice with Robin. Luffy asks Franky to go rescue Robin while he takes care of Lucci.

episodes.name: Episode 285
episodes.description: The Straw Hats must get Robin back before Spandam takes her beyond the Gates of Justice, but they'll have to defeat CP9 in order to free her.

episodes.name: Episode 306
episodes.description: Thinking back on the day Tom was taken from him, Franky crushes Spandam with an elephant. Zoro and the others fight to stay alive underwater.

episodes.name: Episode 287
episodes.description: Zoro and Usopp have a hard time fighting properly with their hands cuffed together. Sanji struggles to deal with Kalifa because she is a woman.

episodes.name: Episode 286
episodes.description: Zoro faces off against Kaku, the strongest swordsman of CP9. Using his Devil Fruit ability, Jabra transforms into a wolf during his battle with Usopp.

episodes.name: The King of the Night! Master Cat Viper Emerges!
episodes.description: Duke Dogstorm’s assertion to Jack that he has no wish to fight falls on deaf ears. Out of options, the duke orders his people to engage the invaders.

episodes.name: A Deadly Elephant Climb! A Great Adventure on the Back of the Giant Elephant!
episodes.description: Luffy and his crew ride Kanjuro’s dragon as it fights against fatigue to climb up the giant elephant’s leg. A plummeting monkey lightens their load.

episodes.name: Curtain-Up on a New Adventure! Arriving at the Phantom Island, Zou!
episodes.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats once again set sail for the phantom island of Zou. On the way, Bartolomeo tells the story of how Luffy met his crewmembers.

episodes.name: Start to Counterattack! Great Moves by the Twirly Hat Crew!
episodes.description: Luffy is reunited with Nami and the rest of the crew to much fanfare from the Mink tribe. Nami recounts what happened while they were separated.

episodes.name: A Battle Begins! Luffy vs. the Mink Tribe!
episodes.description: Luffy rushes ahead and encounters two aggressive members of the Mink tribe. Zoro and the others receive potentially grave news about a crewmate.

episodes.name: The Exterminated Capital! The Twirly Hat Crew Arrive!
episodes.description: Master Cat Viper and Duke Dogstorm keep up the fight by switching places every twelve hours, but Jack loses his patience on the fifth day.

episodes.name: The King of the Day! Duke Dogstorm Appears!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats arrive at the clinic where Duke Dogstorm is being treated. Before entering, they meet his overly enthusiastic subordinate Shishilian.

episodes.name: The New Warlord! The Legendary Whitebeard’s Son Appears!
episodes.description: The crew finds the Sunny moored to the elephant but sees no sign of Nami and the others. Dragon summons the leaders of the Revolutionary Army.

episodes.name: A Threat Descends! The Beast Pirates, Jack!
episodes.description: Wanda reveals how Jack and the Beast Pirates mercilessly destroyed Kurau City after demanding the frightened citizens hand over a samurai named Raizo.

episodes.name: Garchu! The Straw Hats Reunite!
episodes.description: Water erupts from the elephant’s trunk. Luffy gets caught in the flooding, and Kin’emon and Kanjuro’s climb suffers yet another demoralizing setback.

episodes.name: Episode 220
episodes.description: Everyone seems to have lost their memory aside from Robin, who was up reading all night. All of their memories from their time together have vanished.

episodes.name: Episode 208
episodes.description: Foxy takes down Tonjit's beloved horse Sherry in front of everyone. Enraged, Luffy accepts his challenge to face him in the Davy Back Fight.

episodes.name: Episode 226
episodes.description: Foxy tricks the Straw Hats as payback for humiliating him. Nami gives Luffy a hand against Foxy's fiery punching machine by creating rain.

episodes.name: Episode 222
episodes.description: Luffy and the others look for Nami and Zoro, but the people on the island are confused and unable to help. The boy with the flute appears before Zoro.

episodes.name: Episode 221
episodes.description: Luffy and the others recall seeing a boy and hearing the sound of a flute before losing their memories. Nami and Zoro remember their childhood.

episodes.name: Episode 217
episodes.description: Luffy and the others will get their friends back if they win the last round, but losing could decide the fate of their future descendants.

episodes.name: Episode 223
episodes.description: Luffy stays behind by himself to handle Zoro, who glowers at him with animal-like eyes. Sanji directs his anger into kicking the boy with the flute.

episodes.name: Episode 218
episodes.description: Luffy struggles to turn the fight in his favor while having to worry about Foxy's beam attacks. Foxy uses a strange punching machine against Luffy.

episodes.name: Episode 210
episodes.description: Nami's team effortlessly glides through the coral maze and pulls out ahead. As they approach the finish line, Foxy's hand begins to glow.

episodes.name: Episode 219
episodes.description: No matter how many times he gets knocked down, Luffy will get back up to fight for his friends. The two captains clash in the battle's final moments.

episodes.name: Episode 207
episodes.description: Sea monkeys cause trouble after the Going Merry returns to the sea after repairs. The Straw Hats escape to an island where everything is long.

episodes.name: Episode 227
episodes.description: The Straw Hats encounter Admiral Aokiji of the Marines. Luffy warms up to Aokiji after working together to help shipwreck survivors off the island.

episodes.name: Episode 216
episodes.description: The Straw Hats enter the second round in order to get Robin back. As soon as the game starts, the competing participants all rush toward Tonjit.

episodes.name: Episode 225
episodes.description: The Straw Hats rescue Foxy and his crew during a big storm. Foxy tries to get back on his ship, but finds that it has been taken by someone else.

episodes.name: Episode 213
episodes.description: The competitors enter a roller skating race in the third round. Luffy gets to go twice, but he can't even stand without falling in his skates.

episodes.name: Episode 209
episodes.description: The first round involves a race around the island. The Straw Hats split into three teams, but Luffy and Zoro's teams quickly succumb to trickery.

episodes.name: Episode 215
episodes.description: The first round of the new challenge is "Hit & Dead Ball," the oldest game in Davy Back Fight. The Straw Hats wage an all-out offensive.

episodes.name: Episode 212
episodes.description: The opponents openly brandish weapons, but the referee pretends not to notice. Zoro and Sanji finally start working as a team against the cheaters.

episodes.name: Episode 214
episodes.description: The third round continues. Sanji comes up with a clever idea in order for his team to stand a chance against their lightning-quick feline foe.

episodes.name: Episode 228
episodes.description: Usopp and Chopper carry the frozen Robin to the Going Merry for treatment. While they desperately try to save her, Luffy challenges Aokiji to a fight.

episodes.name: Episode 211
episodes.description: Zoro and Sanji enter the Groggy Ring challenge to get Chopper back, but they start arguing instead of working together against their three opponents.

episodes.name: Episode 224
episodes.description: Zoro captures the culprit responsible for taking control of his mind, but Luffy and the others get their memories stolen once again.

episodes.name: Episode 383
episodes.description: Foxy and his crew are after the secrets of a notebook that contains valuable information. Luffy and his mates decide to destroy Spa Island.

episodes.name: Episode 389
episodes.description: Furious with Duval for putting Nami and Robin in harm's way, Sanji kicks away at his enemy's awfully familiar-looking face.

episodes.name: Episode 404
episodes.description: Kid and Law take down another Pacifista together. Rayleigh swoops in with lightning fast speed as Kizaru prepares to finish off Zoro.

episodes.name: Episode 402
episodes.description: Luffy and the others attack the laser-shooting Kuma with all their might. In a different part of the archipelago, another Kuma fights a giant Urouge.

episodes.name: Episode 392
episodes.description: Luffy and the others enter a lawless area where they discover that the coating mechanic Rayleigh has not been around for half a year.

episodes.name: Episode 393
episodes.description: Luffy and the others head to Sabaody Park to look for Rayleigh. Peterman sets his sights on Camie after learning that she is a mermaid.

episodes.name: Episode 390
episodes.description: Luffy and the others stop by the Sabaody Archipelago in order to prepare the Sunny for the underwater voyage to the New World.

episodes.name: Episode 391
episodes.description: Luffy enjoys riding around the Sabaody Archipelago on a bubble vehicle. A pirate with a collar around his neck asks around for help.

episodes.name: Episode 399
episodes.description: Luffy, Kid and Law unleash their Devil Fruit powers on the Marines. Tensions rise when Luffy announces that he will be the one to find One Piece.

episodes.name: Episode 396
episodes.description: Nami and the others stand by to purchase Camie at the auction house, but a Celestial Dragon named Saint Charlos outbids them from the very start.

episodes.name: Episode 405
episodes.description: One by one, the real Kuma makes Luffy's friends vanish into thin air. After whispering something into Rayleigh's ear, Kuma finishes what he started.

episodes.name: Episode 394
episodes.description: Sanji calls in a favor with former adversaries, who zoom around picking up Luffy and the others from different locations around the archipelago.

episodes.name: Episode 403
episodes.description: The Kid and Law pirates fight the Pacifista sent in to fight them. Luffy and the others combine their strongest attacks to take down a Pacifista.

episodes.name: Episode 382
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates run into their old adversary Foxy while unwinding on a floating resort called Spa Island.

episodes.name: Episode 385
episodes.description: The Straw Hats arrive at Red Line. Nami's log pose points straight down into the water, but the path to Fishman Island seems impossible to find.

episodes.name: Episode 400
episodes.description: The Straw Hats head back to Shakuyaku's bar with Rayleigh, Camie and the others. Rayleigh reveals his connection to the pirate king Gol D. Roger.

episodes.name: Episode 387
episodes.description: The Straw Hats head to the location where Hachi is being kept. When they see him in person, they realize they met him back in Arlong Park.

episodes.name: Episode 386
episodes.description: The Straw Hats meet a mermaid named Camie and her starfish Pappag. Nami offers to help their friend Hachi in exchange for a favor.

episodes.name: Episode 401
episodes.description: The Straw Hats must hide from the Marines for the three days it will take for Rayleigh to work on the Sunny. Kizaru wreaks havoc on the archipelago.

episodes.name: Episode 384
episodes.description: The Sunny heads toward its next destination. Brook tries to prove his worth to the Straw Hats after reading about their previous adventures.

episodes.name: Episode 395
episodes.description: The bidding starts at the auction house where Camie is being offered. Usopp informs everyone after finding out that Camie was taken to be sold off.

episodes.name: Episode 398
episodes.description: The local citizens panic when they realize that the Marines will be upon them soon. At Mary Geoise, Kizaru volunteers to take action.

episodes.name: Episode 397
episodes.description: The rest of the Straw Hats follow suit after Luffy beats the snot out of Saint Charlos. Two infamous pirates smile as they watch the chaos unfold.

episodes.name: Episode 388
episodes.description: Zoro slices open the cage holding Hachi and frees him. Luffy crashes into Duval's room and catches a glimpse of what lies under his iron mask.

episodes.name: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Fights a Battle in Extreme Heat!
episodes.description: In a desperate bid to keep his bounty from escaping, Bill uses the full might of his smelting power. But his actions prove costly for Silver Mine.

episodes.name: The Silver Fortress! Luffy and Barto's Great Adventure!
episodes.description: Interrupting the crew's voyage to Zou, the pirate Desire captures Luffy and Bartolomeo and imprisons them on the island of Silver Mine.

episodes.name: The Sword Technique Heats Up! Law and Zoro Finally Appear!
episodes.description: Luffy's group and the abandoned pirates attempt to escape the mine, but Bill's underling Peseta lies in wait to finish them off with his cannons.

episodes.name: An Underground Maze! Luffy vs. the Tram Human!
episodes.description: Soon after falling into an underground tunnel, Luffy, Bartolomeo and Desire desperately avoid the attacks of a tenacious train conductor called Avelon.
